Straight from the New York Times , Team:
" President Trump on [March 31] stepped up efforts to promote his false claims of widespread voting fraud, signing an executive order of questionable constitutionality seeking to create a national list of citizens that would determine voting eligibility and restrict mail ballots. "
Let's be clear: The president has no explicit Constitutional authority over elections, and much of this latest attack on our fundamental right to vote appears difficult to enforce and legally dubious.
This order directs the Department of Homeland Security to create a “ state citizenship list ” based on data from various federal databases. It also directs federal officials to send that made-up list to state election officials, and orders the attorney general to prioritize prosecution of election officials who provide ballots to voters not on the made-up list. It also directs the U.S. Postal Service not to transmit mail-in ballots from any individual not included on Trump's “ state citizenship list ," even though elections are mandated by the constitutional the be run by the states.
This order is yet another sign that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.

subject: Who do YOU want to run for President?
body:

Derek, **We’re just _83 days_ away from Election Day. But once the midterms end, Democrats _need_ to be prepared to hit the ground running ahead of 2028.** The work we do now — _every door we knock, every call we make, every dollar we raise_ — works not only toward winning this year, but towards building the long-term infrastructure Democrats need to win back the White House in 2028. So, as we sprint across the finish line this November and get ready for the marathon ahead, we want to hear from our most engaged grassroots supporters: [**Who do _you_ want to see on the 2028 ticket?**](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260812_2028_survey/?refcode=em_20260812_8531_fr&amount=7&akid=8531%2E22930333%2EOIsa00) **[SHARE YOUR THOUGHTS](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260812_2028_survey/?refcode=em_20260812_8531_fr&akid=8531%2E22930333%2EOIsa00)** Thank you, The Democrats

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

name: R. Cooper
subject: This isn’t an email asking for money
body:
I need people like you with me in this fight, Peter.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1012&source=&t=1&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
| | | |
---
Peter, I’m not here to ask for money.
I’m just asking you to endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. I’m looking for 30,000 signatures, and I’m counting on yours to be one of them. [**_Will you take 30 seconds to add your name?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=9&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
---
I have spent my life trying to do right by the people of North Carolina.
Whether as a state legislator or Attorney General or Governor, I’ve fought hard to protect our fundamental rights, expand health care and put working families first.
I’m running to take this critical work to Washington DC – but right now, the GOP is firing on all cylinders to defeat me. Super PACs are pouring millions into attack ads smearing my name, and President Trump is all in to support my opponent, former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist Michael Whatley.
I know we can defeat Whatley and flip this seat, but I can’t do it alone. I need people like you with me in this fight, Peter.
[**_So if you’re ready to win in North Carolina, take back the Senate and prevent two more years of unchecked Republican rule, will you endorse my grassroots Senate campaign today?**_](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=11&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
---
Every signature helps build the people power we need to win a race this big and important. Thanks for being part of this team.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1012&t=2&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1012&source=&t=3&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)

name: David Hogg
subject: The cost of corporate greed
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We need leaders who are ready to fight for living wages, Medicare for all, and everyday people.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260812-2&t=1&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)
For years, we’ve been told that if you work hard enough, you’ll be able to build a stable life, Peter.
But for millions of working people across this country, that is _far from reality._
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260812_2_m4agigs.1Y1uPl&refcode=em20260812-3863&t=2&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)
A new Government Accountability Office report reveals a devastating reality: **more and more workers at some of America’s largest corporations are relying on public assistance like SNAP and Medicaid because their wages simply aren’t enough to cover the cost of living.**
The number of Amazon employees receiving food stamps and Medicaid has **nearly tripled in just five years**. Nearly **12,350** Amazon workers in the states studied were receiving SNAP benefits, and nearly **11,350** were enrolled in Medicaid.
At the same time, gig economy companies like Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Grubhub, and Instacart are among the top employers of workers receiving these same benefits across multiple states.
While CEOs and shareholders make billions, the people delivering our food, transporting our packages, stocking our shelves, and keeping our economy moving are _struggling_ to afford groceries and health care.
This is exactly what happens when we allow corporations to put profits over people. Our government has been bought off by these major corporations to ensure tax payers pay the price while they refuse to pay their fair share.
Because when workers can’t afford to live on their wages, **everyone pays the price:** Families are forced to choose between rent and medical bills. Workers delay necessary care because they can’t afford it. Parents struggle to provide for their children despite working long hours. And instead of corporations taking responsibility, taxpayers are left filling the gaps.
That’s why electing a new generation of progressive leaders has never been more urgent.
**→ We need** leaders who understand that working people deserve more than survival.
**→ We need** leaders who will fight for a living wage so a full-time job actually provides a path to stability.
**→ We need** leaders who will fight for Medicare for All and a health care system where no one has to worry about going bankrupt because they got sick.
**→ We need** leaders who will stand up to corporations that exploit workers and build an economy where the people who create our prosperity actually share in it.
This moment is about deciding what kind of country we want to build.
Do we accept an economy where some of the wealthiest companies in the world can pay workers so little that they need public assistance? Or do we elect leaders who will fight to make sure every person has the dignity, security, and opportunity they deserve?
That’s why Leaders We Deserve is investing in bold, people-powered candidates who are ready to challenge the status quo and deliver real solutions for working families.
The future we build depends on the leaders we choose today. Together, we can make sure the people are at the center of our politics.
**[If you’re able, will you make a contribution of $5 today to help Leaders We Deserve elect the next generation of progressive leaders who will fight for living wages, affordable health care, and an economy that works for everyone?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260812_2_m4agigs.1Y1uPl&refcode=em20260812-3863&amount=5&t=3&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260812_2_m4agigs.1Y1uPl&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-3863&t=22&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)**
With gratitude,
David Hogg

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Bernie denies it. Brazile excuses it. Michigan elected it.
body:
Plus: New Mexico just made the bar exam optional | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
Bernie Sanders just said he doesn't know a single serious candidate who wants to defund the police, abolish prisons, or open the borders.
EXCEPT....the woman who could be Wisconsin's Democratic nominee for governor by Tuesday night has publicly called for all three. [This is the civil war inside the Democratic Party](https://us.list-manage.com/15GE_04nl7u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e). Bernie denies it's happening, Donna Brazile says it's no big deal, and Michigan just nominated the guy who proves them both wrong.
Meanwhile, New Mexico just decided that passing the bar exam is optional if you want to practice law here. What could possibly go wrong?!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/FpXHUquxM2B?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **BERNIE SAYS THESE PEOPLE DON'T EXIST. WE PULLED UP HER POSTS.
** He said it on Pod Save America, and then blamed Fox News for making it sound worse than it is. Francesca Hong's first post is about white supremacy. The second one calls defunding a first step toward abolishing. The third has nothing to do with police, and it's the one you'll be forwarding to people.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/18vdgh5X6He?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🚨 **DONNA BRAZILE SAID THIS IS JUST LIKE THE TEA PARTY**
She said it Sunday morning on ABC. Same growing pains Republicans had in 2010, nothing to see here. Scott Jennings was sitting right there and read her the actual list of what these people want to abolish. Police. ICE. Borders. The Senate. The Constitution.
Then he brought up the Democratic attorney general in Michigan who says she can't safely attend her own party's convention. Mark ran in a Tea Party cycle. He has some thoughts about that comparison.

📉 **MEDIA RAN THE 23,000 JOBS NUMBER ALL WEEKEND**
Every broadcast led with it. The economy lost 23,000 jobs in July. Here's what nobody mentioned. Private payrolls went up last month. Government payrolls went down by more than that.
Krysty pulls the whole thing apart, then makes a point that has nothing to do with July. It's about the four years before it. Kevin Hassett went on CNN and explained that part of it was snow. In July.

⚖️ **675 HOURS AND YOU'RE A LAWYER IN NEW MEXICO**
That's it. Twelve months following an attorney around, and you never take the bar. You will also never know which one your lawyer did. Krysty asked whether we're doing this with doctors next.

PLUS: Democratic registration in this state hit a number Vince Torres hasn't seen in his lifetime, Gabe Vasquez put the police union's logo on a mailer you paid for, and the tax secretary who called your paycheck a wealth transfer.

| | | Hi there, it's Martin Sheen. I know seeing my name in your inbox might come as a surprise, but I need to talk to you about the country we both love ‐‐ and why I hope you'll fight for it alongside me.

If you don't have time to hear my whole pitch, here's my ask: [**Will you join me in the fight for our future by donating $7 _(generously matched to $21)_ to help my friends at the DSCC take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/23757?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260812-MartinSheen-WhatASKMeans2026RF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260812-MartinSheen-WhatASKMeans2026RF-Pros-sl1&akid=25383%2E9716520%2EYKkKbI)

You see, I was once the "acting" president of the United States ‐‐ and while I may have been playing a fictional role, the lessons I learned were very real.

I'll let you in on the most important one: **Every person has the power to make a difference.**

You might find that hard to believe right now, after everything we've seen and endured in the past year.

I certainly wouldn't blame you for feeling that way.

But look beyond the terrible headlines, and you might just see what I see: Americans of every background and belief, standing up in ways big and small, _sacrificing_ to bring about a future better than our present.

Whether they succeed is, in part, up to you.

One seemingly small action you can take to help is to join with your fellow Democrats and pitch in $7 to help elect a Democratic Senate majority.

Flipping the Senate and bringing accountability to this administration _will_ make a difference, but it will only be possible if we lock hands, raise our voices, and come together ‐‐ that's when we can accomplish truly incredible things.

**The headwinds we face are strong, but we are stronger. Donald Trump is determined, but we are more determined. And right now, as we stretch our arms toward the future, I hope you'll join me.**

TO: U.S. Postal Service
FROM: Willis
Subject: Please don’t cave to Trump.

Dear USPS,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. Along with my signature, I’m chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to ensure we flip the House this November and SAVE vote-by-mail »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/123760?t=9&akid=27546%2E878179%2Ei0I1Ss) | [SIGN THE LETTER ASAP: DEMAND USPS PROTECT MAIL-IN VOTING »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/123760?t=10&akid=27546%2E878179%2Ei0I1Ss)

**_X Willis_**
We can’t let Trump get away with this!
_The Voter Protection Project_

subject: Sorry about Karoline Leavitt
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Chris Pappas for Senate

I’m sorry about Karoline
Leavitt.

Before she was hand-picked as Donald Trump’s White House Press Secretary,
Karoline ran against me for Congress here in New Hampshire. She lost — by
nearly 10 points.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_3.953coN&refcode=em20260812-8278&amount=5&t=1003&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ][IMG]

But that campaign gave her exactly what she needed: a test run for the
MAGA talking points she now repeats from behind the White House podium.
She’s been practicing the spin for years — and while New Hampshire wasn’t
buying it, Trump was.

Let me be clear: I don’t regret a thing about standing up to Karoline and
her MAGA agenda — not then and not now.

This race is going to be tough. National Republicans and John Sununu are
doing everything they can to flip this seat. They’re recycling the same
extremist ideas, running the same playbook and relying on people like
Karoline Leavitt to carry their message.

We beat her once and with your help, we’ll do it again.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_3.953coN&refcode=em20260812-8278&amount=5&t=1004&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Will
you chip in $5 today to help us keep this Senate seat blue
and fight for what matters to Granite Staters?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_3.953coN&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-8278&t=1023&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Donate $5 »

Thanks for being in this fight with me.

Chris Pappas

Peter — I just lost the election for US Congress. But I feel like we won. **Let me tell you why. (Video:**[**Facebook**](https://us.list-manage.com/liZr74Jgel0?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**,**[**Instagram**](https://us.list-manage.com/XPb8izsVKqg?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**,**[**YouTube**](https://us.list-manage.com/14M0Y2bXl5m?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**)**.
First off, thank you to everyone who trusted me with your vote. We'll finish with about 11% of the total ballots cast and over 22k votes while maintaining our pledge not to accept any outside funding.
**This election is over but I'm not going anywhere.** Neither is my team.
It was a remarkable honor to travel the district and meet with voters and hear your stories. To spend hours on the phone discussing your thoughtful questions and dreams for the district.
**This is the beautiful part of politics and it's left me feeling more hopeful than ever.**
Our team is already back at work because our campaign was never about me and we have bigger goals than a seat in Congress. We have fascists to defeat and a country to free from the suffocating grip of billionaires. This is the fight of our lives.
**We've got to keep it rolling. My homepage lists several great orgs,** including ones I'm involved with to get money out of politics, win the midterms, and prepare for a general strike.
Whether you join me and my team, one of these other groups, or another you're familiar with, I hope you'll stay connected and involved. If we continue to build our community, **we will be unstoppable.**

**Please Watch & Share the New Video**
[Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/qwrnkAUMx28?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)[Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/13UD59ujJW8?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)[YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/ROEk_HWUa4i?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)
We're going to continue to AIM HIGHER. See you out there! — Devin & Team

Peter,
Revolting Nazi glorifier, MAGA culture warrior, and GOP nominee for Congress Brandon Herrera just earned critical support and financial backing rom Speaker of the House Mike Johnson.
Johnson is now actively fundraising for a vile man who, as recently as 2022, recorded a video on YouTube testing a WWII submachine gun while goose-stepping to a Nazi marching song. Herrera called the machine gun "the original ghetto blaster."
Mike Johnson frequently says Democrats hate Israel and are the party of anti-Semitism. But he's the one supporting a neo-Nazi for Congress.
In 2023, Herrera attacked gun safety advocate Shannon Watts by making disgusting and crude remarks about mothers: "Being a mother doesn't make your opinion any more or less valid. Just because you let somebody creampie you doesn't mean I have to give a shit about your political opinions. The fact that you kept your cum trophy doesn't make you any less wrong about the dumb shit that you say."
Ultra pro-life "Family Man" Mike Johnson has no problem with that apparently.
On a podcast in 2024, Herrera said that we should "abolish old people" and called for dismantling Social Security. He fantasized about mass murdering senior citizens.
Still Mike Johnson stands with him.
I'm fed up with Johnson and his endless hypocrisy, fake piety, and moralizing. Mike Johnson is a stain on America. He's a stain on our history. This blue wave election year, it's time to wash him out of office--and I am just the farmer and Democrat who is going to do it.

name: Lee Perry
subject: *Mark your Calendar* Election Day GOTV Events
body:
****SAVE THE DATE** Election Day August 18th for back to back events!*

Election Day is almost here, and we need you with us on* Tuesday, August
18th!*

We’ve rented the Sanford Women’s Club for the *entire day*, making it our
central GOTV headquarters before we come together that evening for our
Election Night Watch Party.

*Here’s how you can get involved:*

-

*10:00 AM-7:00 PM Phone Banking:* Join our full-day GOTV phone bank.
Come for an hour or stay all day and help us reach voters. Register Here
<https://marialana-kinter-for-congress.solidarity.tech/full-day-phone-bank>
-

*2 Canvassing events:* We’ll launch *two canvassing events* from the
Sanford Women’s Club throughout the day. Knock doors, talk with voters, and
help turn out our supporters. 10 AM canvass register here
<https://marialana-kinter-for-congress.solidarity.tech/election-day-canvass-morning>
and
a 5 pm canvass register here.
<https://marialana-kinter-for-congress.solidarity.tech/election-day-canvass-evening>

-

*7:00 PM Watch Party:* Join Team Marialana Kinter and Central Florida
supporters of Angie Nixon for our *Election Night Watch Party*. We’ll
have food, vegan options, a cash bar, a DJ, live music, speakers, and
election results. Register here
<https://marialana-kinter-for-congress.solidarity.tech/watch-party-with-team-angie-nixon-marialana-kinter>
to attend and register here
<https://marialana-kinter-for-congress.solidarity.tech/watch-party-with-team-angie-nixon-marialana-kinter>
to volunteer at the event itself)

*Location:*
Sanford Women’s Club
309 S. Oak Ave. Sanford, FL 32771

*NOTE *- Angie Nixon will be at her hometown watch party in Jacksonville,
but her Central Florida supporters will be joining us in Sanford to
celebrate Election Night.

Whether you can make calls, knock doors, help with setup, or simply join us
that evening, *we want you there.* Every conversation and every door
matters, and we want to finish this grassroots campaign surrounded by the
people who made it possible.

*All ages are welcome at the watch party. You must be 21+ to drink, and IDs
will be checked at the bar. Free food will be available and its first come
first serve. There will be a DJ and bands performing with additional guest
speakers. The building must be cleared by 11:30 PM. *

Come spend Election Day with us. *Make calls. Knock doors. Turn out voters.
Then celebrate with us that night.*

Sign up to volunteer and let us know when you’ll be there!

Thank you!
Lee

--

Days ago, after a rocky confirmation process, Trump's former personal attorney Todd Blanche was sworn in as the next Attorney General, the highest law enforcement official in the land.
Blanche is a corrupt guy. As Deputy Attorney General, he was involved in DOJ actions that repeatedly skirted the law. He engineered Trump's IRS settlement, granting Trump and his family total immunity from audits. He oversaw the $1.8 billion slush fund set aside to compensate January 6th rioters. And he was involved in the DOJ's coverup of the Epstein files.
Now Blanche gives Trump a new puppet atop the Department of Justice, and a new weapon to point at democracy itself. He's repeatedly defended the idea of sending ICE to polling sites for the midterm elections, asking, "Why is there objection to sending ICE officers to polling places?"

Blanche's nomination just months before the midterm elections should raise major alarm bells. Early voting is almost here and I want to give you a direct update from the ground.
Starting now, Turning Point PAC will be shifting into higher and higher gears every week as we fund the immediate surge of ballot-chasers across America.
This week: **Arizona. Nevada. Michigan. Pennsylvania. Ohio. Indiana. Wisconsin. New Hampshire.**
We've been on calls with our teams in every one of these states this week. The energy is there. More chasers are being recruited, and trained. The infrastructure we've been building since January is ready.
**[What we need now is the resources to run it at full speed](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Njd9AAwAAAAAAlEh9tQ8iQF5SMU7fKOylQNGS7NGIUfkjlpH2IkC6PevmwIdmmsZDpfhz9yJnrxuDO3xHj7Pn5B5Mw5Q_KsIk6eRyq_vVOsxfylsUItC)** — because early voting begins in fewer than **eight weeks** and there is no recovery window if we come up short.

Let me be direct about what this moment means.
Midterm races are decided by turnout margins that would look like rounding errors in a presidential race. A few thousand votes in a handful of swing districts in Michigan or Pennsylvania or Nevada — that's the difference between keeping the House and handing Hakeem Jeffries and his communist caucus the gavel!
Our ballot-chasers are in those districts **right now.**

The stories that Sailors and Marines deployed in support of our needless war with Iran weren't being fed proper meals began circulating in April. It was clear the Department of Defense was having serious trouble supplying the fleet with food. Most of the stories seemed to come from 5,000 Sailors and Marines on the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln, but if it was happening on one ship, it was probably happening across the fleet.
We're now four months into reports of food shortages on the Lincoln, and things are reported to be getting worse. The Lincoln was supposed to be on a seven-month, 210-day deployment. They have been deployed for over 250 days, have just completed 40 days of sustained combat operations, and have recently learned their deployment has been extended again.
The members of our armed forces risk their lives in the defense of our nation. They do so trusting that this nation will take care of them while they stand in harm's way. This administration has broken that trust with our servicemen and women, and they seem incapable of fixing the problem.
The House and Senate Armed Services Committees have a moral and constitutional obligation to investigate matters such as this. But the GOP-led congressional committees are too afraid to speak up for the men and women serving our nation in a war they never needed.

A new ACLU of Alabama report calls Alabama the "most dangerous" state for pregnancy and childbirth, citing a maternal mortality rate nearly twice the national average and significant racial disparities. The report identifies rural healthcare shortages, transportation and financial barriers, limited mental health support, and negative experiences with medical providers as major challenges, and recommends expanding access to doulas and midwives, postpartum care, and maternal healthcare services.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
This week we recorded the Alabama Politics This Week podcast with Josh Moon and David Person, one of the state's largest political podcasts. They asked thoughtful questions about what it means to serve, lead, and create change in Alabama.

I believe service is patriotism in action. Loving your country and your community means being willing to ask difficult questions, hold leaders accountable, and work toward a better future. Patriotism does not belong to one political movement or one set of beliefs. It belongs to anyone willing to show up, serve others, and help build a stronger community.

That work starts close to home.

Every conversation with a neighbor, every town hall, every yard sign placed, every question asked, and every volunteer who steps up helps build something bigger than any one candidate. These actions may seem small on their own, but together they give communities a voice and create the momentum needed for change
We are 84 days away from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

clean_body: You Don't Want to Miss This | | | | | == | | | CAMPAIGN UPDATE | | | | | | | We have never hidden the fact that I come from a union family, that we support workers' right to collectively bargain, and that we are running a pro-union campaign. We think that goes hand in hand with fighting for working families. This week we got some great news. We have been endorsed by both the Alabama State AFL-CIO and the Alabama Communications Workers of America. We are sincerely thankful to the working men and women who make up those unions. | | == | MAKING HISTORY | | THE WEEK AHEAD | | Calhoun County Town Hall 🗓️ August 11 🕓 6 - 8:00 P.M. 📍Jacksonville Train Depot 650 Mountain St NW Jacksonville, AL | | Etowah County Democratic Women's Club Community Picnic 🗓️ August 13 🕓 5 - 8:00 P.M. 📍Kiwanis Pavilion at Noccalula Falls Park 1500 Noccalula Road Gadsden, AL 35904 | | | Back to School Food Truck Festival 🗓️ August 14 🕓 5 - 9 P.M. 📍 Downtown LaFayette | | Community Yard Sale 🗓️ August 15 🕓 8 A.M. 📍 Valley, AL | | | Community Conversations A non-partisan forum to help community members make informed voting decisions 🗓️ August 15 🕓 11 A.M. - 1 P.M. 📍 1606 SW 19th St Lanett, AL | | Tallapoosa County Town Hall 🗓️ August 8 🕓 2- 4 P.M. 📍 Sportsplex Cabin 1685 Arena Rd Alexander City | | | THE WEEK BEHIND | | | | | | | | | We drove over to Anniston to support the 1,000 Miles To Memphis Voting Rights March. We visited the historic Freedom Riders sites in the city and then had lunch at CalCo Democratic Headquarters. | | | | | | | Our town hall at the Alex City Sportsplex had a great crowd who asked a lot of great questions. | | | | | | | After Alex City we headed home to attend the East Alabama Black Chamber of Commerce Annual Scholarship Gala. They honored three young entrepreneurs who are working hard to start businesses in really tough times. We were proud to be Patron Level Donors for this great event. | | | | | | | We worshiped at the Fresh Oil Full Gospel Church in Opelika. Bishop Henry Ligon, Pastor Laura Ligon and my good friend Alexis Ligon lead a wonderful church full of great people. | | | In Case You Missed It | | BLOG POSTS | == The stories that Sailors and Marines deployed in support of our needless war with Iran weren't being fed proper meals began circulating in April. It was clear the Department of Defense was having serious trouble supplying the fleet with food. Most of the stories seemed to come from 5,000 Sailors and Marines on the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln, but if it was happening on one ship, it was probably happening across the fleet. We're now four months into reports of food shortages on the Lincoln, and things are reported to be getting worse. The Lincoln was supposed to be on a seven-month, 210-day deployment. They have been deployed for over 250 days, have just completed 40 days of sustained combat operations, and have recently learned their deployment has been extended again. The members of our armed forces risk their lives in the defense of our nation. They do so trusting that this nation will take care of them while they stand in harm's way. This administration has broken that trust with our servicemen and women, and they seem incapable of fixing the problem. The House and Senate Armed Services Committees have a moral and constitutional obligation to investigate matters such as this. But the GOP-led congressional committees are too afraid to speak up for the men and women serving our nation in a war they never needed. | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | ALABAMA IN THE NEWS | 📰 == The Senate Agriculture Committee failed to advance the farm bill after Democrats opposed the bill's one-year delay of new SNAP cost-sharing requirements for states. In Alabama, the changes could require the state to pay an estimated $174 million and could affect food assistance for roughly 648,000 residents, while the farm bill remains stalled ahead of the current extension's September expiration. | 📰 == Rural hospital closures and service reductions across Alabama are forcing residents to travel long distances or even relocate to access essential and specialized healthcare. Thomasville's hospital closure highlights how financial pressures, low reimbursements, staffing costs, and policy barriers are worsening healthcare access while also threatening rural communities' economic stability. | 📰 == A new ACLU of Alabama report calls Alabama the "most dangerous" state for pregnancy and childbirth, citing a maternal mortality rate nearly twice the national average and significant racial disparities. The report identifies rural healthcare shortages, transportation and financial barriers, limited mental health support, and negative experiences with medical providers as major challenges, and recommends expanding access to doulas and midwives, postpartum care, and maternal healthcare services. | A CALL TO ACTION | As we come down to the last three months, we need you to do four things: First, we need you to get the word out. This is a grassroots campaign which means we're going to rely heavily on you. Share our posts, talk to your friends, and show off those yard signs and bumper stickers. If you don't have a yard sign, email mailto:joinus@leemcinnis4alabama.comto let us know what county you're in, and we'll hook you up with the person in your county who has some. == == == | Second, we need to meet your friends. One asset we have in this campaign is a candidate who will meet with people and have a conversation. Sometimes those conversations can be tough, but they're always productive. Set up a group meeting either in person (which is great) or virtually (which is also great). Email mailto:joinus@leemcinnis4alabama.com to let us know where you are, and we'll work out the details with you. | | | Third, make a plan to vote. We don't know what is going to happen between now and November 3, but the best way to ensure a free and fair election is to show up in huge numbers. Once you have your plan, help your friends and neighbors plan to vote. | | | Fourth, donate to the campaign. You have all been incredibly generous financially, but we are entering the expense phase of this race. Barb and I haven't charged the campaign for gas, meals, or hotel rooms so that we could save money for these last 90 days. Without corporate or foreign-interest PAC money, we knew we would have to run a slim campaign, but now we have to start getting our name in front of a wider audience, and that will require capital. | | == | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | This week we recorded the Alabama Politics This Week podcast with Josh Moon and David Person, one of the state's largest political podcasts. They asked thoughtful questions about what it means to serve, lead, and create change in Alabama. I believe service is patriotism in action. Loving your country and your community means being willing to ask difficult questions, hold leaders accountable, and work toward a better future. Patriotism does not belong to one political movement or one set of beliefs. It belongs to anyone willing to show up, serve others, and help build a stronger community. That work starts close to home. Every conversation with a neighbor, every town hall, every yard sign placed, every question asked, and every volunteer who steps up helps build something bigger than any one candidate. These actions may seem small on their own, but together they give communities a voice and create the momentum needed for change We are 84 days away from the general election. **Good Morning!** On this day in 1942, Col. James C. Marshall, who led the Army Corps of Engineers' Syracuse, New York, district, [set up the Manhattan Engineer District](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtugzAUQL_GbEF-gCGDhy5s6doR3ZhrcOIHsi9E-fuq7Sd0PcM50vm6zTfwwaf1EyIacnlO-KoBibDMVI64PxF3n9ZKBTwFeGKpYpZc6gsfL0LNYMmfOHfQLMYhSlQNGjGMWou-u16bzUhllbJqGdSgXM_vw3i_awGjVf0Veukab358fBRKcN71unUoBR-VdD3obnCKdRwXT7m0j-wTbejCO59YWptjE8xGtFemPpicmJxgc206bEAo8ah4xDaX9Y8zOW2-Ui5vJqcIaQMiSJe95AdaYnJqiln2lw_BVz2wjq8RfPit0D_nnEZ-BwAA__8EHnoO) in New York City. It's more commonly known now as the Manhattan Project that created the first atomic bomb at Los Alamos, New Mexico. Millions of people from Greenland to Spain watched the sun vanish behind the moon on Wednesday, and the [pictures don't disappoint](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUD2z3CAQ-zV2xw0fNtwVFGmue2lTejZ4sTcPAwP7zpP8-oyvS51S0kgj6cfH8gGUKG_f4UDPsSwZz56QGdvC7euon4iV8ta5AXGCT2xdLVpqK-RdKLNAYHrhMsG4-oio0Yzolbtbq-bp8Rh3r6MBF-I8P5xWbgq4gkVrDIKZnVM_R_JXnrwro6ScZnuLqJW8Gx1nsJOLZpgkrsSl3X4VyrxjTL_LC9stlGNMfmeufTDfBv0c9PM8z1uvEPBSB_3sDG2DP5S3C5QETWBIVDv2QT-5MCTxDy3e63hvlFIXB6VEJXdxEu8CROevnClvIpR-UBC9YmAICUXdC5cuXrRiGZtf63lZu3XDJLcDKL3r8n--_PL6bwAAAP__olOWDg). Find them in _Science_ below, then tell us in today's poll whether you've ever caught an eclipse yourself. Do you remember exactly where you were on 9/11? Most of us can still picture the room, the faces, and the TV screen as if it were yesterday. Scientists call it a "flashbulb memory," a moment so powerful your brain takes a photograph and keeps it sharp for decades while ordinary days vanish completely. Only a handful of events in modern history have burned themselves into nearly every American's mind that same way, and researchers have measured which ones cut the deepest. So how many of them do you remember? Today on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Ayla counts down the moments Americans will never forget. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzzFywyAQQNHTQGcNLAhJBUUad06bklmLxSZGQoM2cnz7THKFHOD_mfdxCRfMJa-3d1zIc6phpedeiJla4Pa1bA-iLa-3nRtmLvigtusACtxJjSdtAs6cDwoWZfSJCMhI8noYndO9nSZ597E3EaY0IwxkDE1a6SvF2c5IlGBIMvvfnxq10UrZ3nWJQKvRQOrR2SEZYRXFzLV1nzWvfKdUXvWg1s11kcXfmbddmDcBZwHnRteGa-zKS8B5q5G-uaGWzcftmUvJuxuEVbcFc_nr-Z_sw8NPAAAA__-6lm1m)! ## Trump Declares Tight Grip on Strait of Hormuz
President Trump posted on Wednesday that the United States has "total control" of the Strait of Hormuz, writing, _"I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT,"_ while Iranian officials shot back that the strait "remains blocked" until its conditions are met. [See the President's post here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAUBOCngW5Xhx8DLiiudOVuU0VKaRH7sCaLjQVnvcrbR84rpJ2RPmnm4zbeQsppu7-FFT3FMm74ahmJsI5Un-v-QNzTdm9UQ6IcHlibGCVIcwF3EWoME6UDRx347COiRMXRC-uMEZ3ue774z0lDFE7H3slO9ZOYbeckzAZRWegVT_70wAklAHRnrhGlAKdk7ILRNiqmAedEpV6_StpowZi_y4H1OpWVZ78Q7Y2pf0wOTA5Un7S0MqWQz_4MNVQM-X_ZQp7fz1FMDntp1JgchLDgFAhrHEglTG959fP-SjmnZizTcF9D-qU4_fGhw8ufAAAA___ESHg8). The standoff is escalating at sea. A Navy helicopter fired two Hellfire missiles into a cargo ship's engine room after it tried to run the blockade of Iran's ports, the third vessel disabled since July. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DvO2zAQBODTUB0NvvRwwSKNuj9tSmEtLq2NKVEgVxKS0wd2jvDXAwzmm19f0xdQou35E1b0HPO04VUTMmOZuBzr_kLcaXtWLkCc4IWl6sko00k1SG0nmJlOnBw0wUdEg7ZBr_uh63Tr7vdm8dZp2yqt7w-lZtcZE5wxKlgc9KNXARvy7z41aKuVcm13i2i0GqyJLXSuj1Y4hYE4l9vvTBsvGNOffGK5zXltkl-Y9yrsD2FGYcbrum7zo74d71yYMdGJ8tgDMFZhRiqwyQuKPKoMeYMU5Ecq_xvlkst6_JVcIEaaZYSUqlzywQtV-aKUZMEgK4IwY1N82C9KiWrXC6eeK1D6zOJvvnl68y8AAP__4SCMBQ). Iran-backed Houthi rebels, meanwhile, [killed six people](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMHOnSAUhJ8Gdxg4KOqCRZPG3e22S4N41NOLYgC17dP_8b7Cv_wyyWS--f0aXpY87csvu6HJcxh2vJPHnDEOOZ7b8UY8aF9Sjpayt2-MSQ4gQHPRcqkG6zJdOFS2mMyMCKgKNLJptZZ11XXFapSA2nUV6s5JUQsxjnKEpu7QjShagILM0ydaqaQQVa3LGUGKVsFcW101s2KVwIlyiOWfQHtecfb_woWxdGErvFlzPhJTPxj0DPr7vss5_H08npxB7-lC_jCDnqLd-W3jh_nHkFOKFj1fQ9zO_9yey5kyl8BUv6Xg3jQx9VOoumnHdpSua7QbtVBKdyhRTnbSk7JFNNNxk_eUdMMqsWyW_Gdf_uatl4GvAAAA__-l3Ivp) on a cargo ship off Yemen, the first deaths from the group's attacks on shipping in this round of fighting. Tuesday's tally of eight vessels fell below a 10-day average of about 12, for the lowest daily count since Aug. 5, down from about 130 a day before the war. The ceasefire expires Aug. 17, with no extension talks underway, a senior Iranian source says.

name: Dan Cox
subject: 5 Days
body:
The next five days could determine your children's future in Maryland. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8495e14fef64/6-days-6756355?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
---
| |
# 5 Days to Determine Our Children's Future.
Dear friend, The current "administration" is absent. Absent from building the Key Bridge; from accepting the federal education scholarships of $1700 per student for our most needy students; from helping the disabled community and instead taking $300 million out of DDA (including the matching fund); from negotiating to keep our beloved Preakness leg of the Triple Crown - instead, wasting the $600 million in taxpayer dollars used to buy Maryland horse racing.

_And absent from helping the nearly 300,000 residents being cut off from their electric right now - more than three times last year's number - because of outrageous electric bill increases_ ; it is this Moore administration's failed government policies alone that are harming our State.

All while they are actively seeking a constitutional amendment to steal the last voice in Congress of Republicans by permanently arrogating to the Legislature and Governor the power to gerrymander.

## Two Killed in Salado Apache Crash
Two Army pilots were killed when an AH-64 Apache attack helicopter [crashed into a field near Salado](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O3SAUBOCnwR0WYPxDQZHG3aZNaR0fDtdoMVhA7N23j27yCKlHGs03vz62DwgxpNdPOMm2L5-3RE-N1BqVDfOz5-_a8nVD_E0F0mdIrwplU0JNXCxcDhtgCzdtGjpnd-GM7MjKeZkmuRhtusN6T-RwV0KRHyatEQahYUaz7DCDmbtg33VikYOUQindC292J1ENg9slas-0IBdaLn07qNEXVB-_802lx3x20R6tXZUNP5hamVqf5-k_kVK73zFTK5QWMBJT69vG1BozQmRqvSIk4ligHlS5y0_iFSK4zCtSIl7ohJAq_0dkah2F4MuIxoCb-Sglcu0d8R2M5uDHUejFIUrRFeuuJ8QY6jQzLV4nhPh3bPvfk2-r_gQAAP__7dmSbg) on Wednesday afternoon. The [1st Cavalry Division](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGupCAUxvGnwQ4DiI4WFNvYzbZbmgMcR7IoBs6V8e1v5r7C7b_8ku__77k8IcRwvP7Cjobea1oOrCUiEebFpWrTXSidF8QvzHD8D8erQF6UUAMXI5fdAo7ChYuGxhsr_CQbNPIxDoMcJz01m5nk2Fs5eKdX2Q04Yq-GHvrpYXvp9WSbYD6cGGUnpVBKt2KdrJdOdZ230umVaYE-UMotbUj4hrLGO12YW5f2JpqN6Cys-8PUzNRca20viBFvhwdliJ8VU_PnGFMz1cQ9gufh4GvKxLeUPN9DDAT55m5L54mZuwxlY2pusvFnDTGGMjyYFq8dwo_Y0G97XUZ9BwAA__--DoKm) helicopter went down around 1:30 p.m. in a private field off Dove Hollow Lane, [about 20 miles southeast of Fort Hood](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULGO5CAU-5qkIwKSYaCguCbdXHtl9AKPCRoSIniXzPz9Kqv9g60s25Jl-99jekBMcXv-hRUtvUOeNjxrQiIsk8vnnD-V8n5A-o8FtlfcnhXKJLlUjGsm-gkcxQOnAVpvZ-6NaNGKu1ZKaDOYdrFeOuW14_wW8Ga0ctIB12j8DUzP1dxGe8VxLXohuJRDx4OZvXCy7_0s3BCagaOPlEtHCxK-oYb0yQeWzuW1TXYh2mvT_2nk2MjxPM_uRXW9zEaO154LgGLeILEfLplH8AwCYWFrTJGgfNiCKbq8X5orUBesDIiFXIgtOftGjm2xfj9jSrGqezPw5woxffeg3_53WPkVAAD__1keiH4), where it was based. It hit no structures and no one on the ground, said Bell County Sheriff's Office spokesman Cliff Coleman. "_It was a violent crash_ ," Coleman said. The wreck sparked a grass fire that [burned about 100 acres](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3ypCAUxE-DGRY8WD8Cgk3MZtMNrSc8R2oQLGB15vZbzhX-cXd1_7r_PuYH-uDj8w_uZOp7TXOkqwSqlfJs07WkT6npODH8o4zx5eOzYJ5BQMfFwKWa0VZ_0qyxcWYRbpQNGdkPXSeHUY_NZrQkgQC0DGpVHfR2UEunpeu7FZdfo2i8uePEIJWUAkC3Yh0XJy0o5RZp9cq0IOdrym3dqNIbyxo-6aTc2rQ3wWy1HoWp3wwmBtN1Xe09wm4YIwUpbheD6S5hMImBwSSBwVSvxF8-BHIc10qZY-R4oN2I7z74ivnDNwrepuNWbcaykeORMPOCAV3iXxgGU5ONOy4fgi9dz7R47ujDl67-9NXTwP8AAAD__3WvjhA) on Wednesday, forcing several nearby homes to evacuate and shutting down FM 2843 near the site. "_Our thoughts are with the crew and their families as we await further information_ ," said Brig. Gen. Ethan Diven, the acting commanding general at Fort Hood. The Army [is investigating](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3O4yAURJ8Gd0SAbWwKim3cfdtuafFzCSjEWHBjJ2-_cvYRtp0jnRnNn5_1x6Sctvtv8wSN71DWDc6WARHq6sppy6dh2Q-TX1DN9kjbvZm6CiYkZTPl_WocpgPWwXReW-YV70DzaZaSz2pQXdQjjBObHbdy6iej1CyC7f04jUG5WVrZJX3p2Mx7zpkQw40FZT13ou-95W4IZGDgE5Z6wwgIb9NC_pQD6s2VZ5d1RNwb6X8RsRCxGOumCxCx7KUhEUsoFWksxdMIObmyI1TqqmmRCvpIOYOnZ4TtXwaNOtiwmky_XdS8MJaaMF2kbCHVy82VlGrkioilq9rvZ8o5NTmRgd2fJuXvNvzfTw8t_gYAAP__PY6OFQ).
## Abbott Proposes 10-Year Prison Sentences
Gov. Greg Abbott proposed Tuesday that Texas educators convicted of an improper relationship with a student serve [at least 10 years in prison](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZB7ZDWNwQHAJ2V56IbLdzWCtByO7B3b-_sT8woalKj3p1b-v-cvFFLfHX_ekkX-WPG901kTMVOaQT5_flfN-uPSi4rbvuD2qKzMoMFINUrezCxwPmjvX4OgVWt3QqPvBGD3YzjbrqO93q9yAS7C671GHgL1HNNovFsj7Jo4XTg261VoBdDe1WI86QNui16FbRKcII-dy45WYflxd0jsfVG4hP5s0rsx7Fe0fAZOA6TzP2_eaX1cpYHKFY0gkYLrMBEwpB5cETB_QNfA-M8tPlISv4DiXKuNzL3mnIiu_kDaWhZLjmLe6xr1KreSbXLkAMNxl6JUxHRhpqQfZ2WCkNzBIg2iIvG2xtU0ZcT9jSrGaXnTq8XQxfRT4t9cfI_wPAAD__yCTmj0) and register as sex offenders. The plan, [laid out at a Lubbock roundtable](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAURL8Gd0SAHWIXFNu4y7ZbWhgu8VUwILhxkr9f-f3Cq2c0Z3T-3Ze7xYjp8dfuYOgT8pLg3SIQQV1cfq_52yiXw8YXVJuemB7N1kUJpbkYuewX6wgPWAbbebMKP8kOjLyNWstxGqZuM9eg_VUF36-9vjmtJ9Deq-ClENfJutChOefEKHsphVLDRYRp9dKpvverdENggwCPlOuFNiD42BbiNx9QLy7vXTQbUWms_8PUzNT8PNCeAVNzyREJXWNqPhFMzWJkapaSqdmuaybipeaSGzQuBf-CrbxUbDnxHRPur52HXDnuZwsqJ7Bug8obvTwk4hWiJcypbVhOSFeNL2-MEZu-sUE8dovx5yT9Vu5h1P8AAAD__0rVkcs) with law enforcement officers and school superintendents, would also block parole, community supervision, and deferred adjudication for anyone convicted. "_This new law builds on previous and vital actions that crack down on inappropriate teacher-student relationships_ ," Abbott said. "_We must protect our students and lock up predators_." House Speaker Dustin Burrows said the House will partner with the governor on the [tougher penalties](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGO3SAQRb_G7uYJMPGDwkUad5s2pTXAYKPwjAXz7N2_j7xSviDVFKN7ro7u74_lA1NO-_oLXzTxZyzLTlfLxEx18eVy5atxOU7Mb6q4_0n72rAuSqgRhAE5LOg5nbRo7MPkRLCyp0k-zThKY7Xtt8kHOY7DMBrvtJdoRvt8xnGIgqzBH1L0abpxwshBSqGUfohoXZBeDUNw0uvYaUEhcakP3ojpE1vMX-Wk-vDl1edpYz5aN_zs1Nyp-bquxxUR72enZqycfKZOzbdZp-ZcPOZOzd-gfxfWcsJaaQV0rjDDUctRGjXg8l43qnDQjpkTNaDw9silNvBlP5NnCpBed4AqVMrIqextS0eDxu9AO981yjzBGT9E7SIIpR1oETw41BGMjd6IgNaK0NcpHFfKObXx2WmxvjDlb1H-34HOSf0NAAD__6egqaE) next session. "_To the survivors: we hear you, we see you, and what happened to you should never have happened,_ " Burrows said.
## Cowboys Top Sports Value Rankings
The Dallas Cowboys remain the [most valuable sports franchise](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAQRb8Gd3QA0dYFi9m4e7OdpSmgVDI0GCj19d9PnPQfvF0llXty7_nzNX9BiCGtv-GFhr6XPCe8akQiLLPLl83vSnk_IR5YIP0Naa1QZiVUz8XAZTuDo3DirKHxxgo_ygaNfA59L4dRj81moIMOvLVCihGle7bWtt3i9SA0iGVwTTA3TgyylVIopR9iGa2XTrWtt9LphWmBPlAuD9qQ8BvqEt_5xPJw-dVEsxHtlbW_mJqYmjaE831_mJrqngtVpqa0RKYmDzFC5Z9dTE2fi69IvNKRUkgrlx3vuA0xhpz4rYND5fXYsXCbr8i3IxF3OVFIB96Uphi_X3eg9k-mxfqCEP93o586PY36FwAA__-QeY_-) in the world, with Sportico's latest rankings showing that the team is worth $15.5 billion. The Houston Texans have catapulted up to an $8.6 billion valuation. The Cowboys' valuation jumped from $12.8 billion last year and has more than doubled since Sportico valued Dallas at $6.43 billion in 2020. The Los Angeles Rams rank second at $12.7 billion, followed by the New York Giants at $12 billion. [See full list](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMR3IXhsDhYtr6HLtlWgxS2KdwcjeQPL2p0T3Bn8_mtE3f27TDUMM-_03buT4taZpp6tEYqY8-XTN6V04HSfGJ2Xc_4b9XjBPIMHWsq-VntBzOGkyWC1ulsugKnKq661V_WCG6uGgRTlo3-Ew9y1B22mjLXlCjdBa6qrgPnWyV1opCWAauQ7zojxovczKm1UYSUvglBt-ENMLyxrf6aTc-LRV0T2YjyL0LwGjgPG6rqYcKXPw6RMQMK6E_MwkYNzXWDPhVn9Fpf5vqmMoXCvQxvZG2VbAWGW3HFeIMRTbCSPvG4b4HeSfHnU6-BcAAP__gJR-MQ). Meanwhile, the Texans rank 13th in the NFL, with their value rising 21% from roughly $7.1 billion last year. Houston entered the league as an expansion franchise in 2002 for just a [$700 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAUhE9jukX-A-zCRRq6TZsSGfsBVgxG9gvevX1ErpBmRpqRvuL7ek5PG2I41k-7g8HXkqYDaomACHlyqc7pXTCdl40_kO3xHY612DxxyvsHVQ8mJuswXDBJ23gzU69ZA4YNqu-Z0lI3m9HKzl2nQQ1CD96Dm2UnhR6suxfaN8HcOKqYYIxyLlu66Nkzx4XwM3NyIZKCD5hyixsgvGxZ4jtdkFuX9iaaDfEsRHwQPhI-1lpbKOdxn4SPxxLvhFoIH5nW-i5KO8JHrbqhbzfcY5ONP2uIMZR-IJKuuw3xj47_tXIZ_hsAAP__NzJ1QQ) fee. body:
I looked at the numbers. Your file is empty. Let's fix that right now. |
Patriot,

I have spent thirty years reading voter data. I know what a healthy file looks like -- and I know what a gap looks like.

Right now, your file has a gap.

**_[The 2026 Republican Policy Assessment is still sitting incomplete — and that is the one thing I need you to fix before tonight.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=0c949e3c73334aa9b5e5381595c0f3fd&_e=oD77LP3Mj958PlxvVlAoX-EC9Pc27mFmZ__ygtKM8zo-yK8rQhV4Iqhw3_x-CL22BLmSJ0EY7pjl2kxBJQA9p0FIzHTtHGHE1UPk786tpTeF-2AHOdJlLaAp62mQnKTM-3VvQoQy4CE0yIM5txF2hA0hJHtGB4r7diAVDNjdwStLWiou8WY_kVJN8HMccTbleuA2DfjQrmFOswN_gouQmZOh5R2AeS6QFphcpDNi1W29qp8OwMmB0Ish0VOjiSze6S9PGxMP4uLJ3RT4v1n5Y9ASEwQTXnU8jsLstNPRUxz_88KwNpiU4ENBuKSti79eamrZZ6akoeg91Ht6rQEUhC-CJWdbnV4Hve4qpW124JtQqHvtVbgmWVmV0u7hgsAokdpZBOLf_mN5mZ_DW8vjkdDAKS-9YuZbP3ohMaUQptKaUosbrDf_sB-vWSemXqOlzmreWILoKZNH1U23V3AinKRQUhRccoijRr7dOVYjZDbs_XjebbSNyzHt-wU9Xn-XkFKlbvqGnLje10jWzdx8IWHCpfnyz85DSspdNjPpBzQ60XlQL26R9Zp9vlEuSXMqrJ31JVG-5eJmAuiu586IIOqI3Mb-6QfudgSQo1X0uGWaHfBitluP3zYvDMHKyq8hNDKcl3G5QTphnmqvQUnSFdEMAr6CMprJ9u-16XX_9hz9g41-aWyume8nCA9sLnd9FbSgQYJxE31C9zvjyOwoDhXzruXq93YObVgx-AsgwV0WY7yYHA5iJj5AMp-515q7iPVSgjyIKC0L502ciBRzcQp6_LHrHJ0px5G2mmdhAz72D89EDIIg6ZGinlWI8RRPVtJxp9Z49SdXZqccUbNvH6dIbyB8m4xKUf29MVZphszZOwdHRkCaDMUW6QxhMjR5BqYgEOSb6CGzULM50aKLbxvyq7XvyW6h20h9UkrskYD1u4SnDu6WvcaTtDSngVlFVHZHJWNlIQIRkB-t8YRcFL2VLTs2MJO1D2uRepZh1ecMF-rMP0IUmARbzI7kgwcUam4ZVWPDPVHf3mRtjgn4DeDjiOOW704WK7vJ5Z2FS7KEx0Goj6Q72MQlLIBY2hej5ZCl7ySjMnFOtb_hrLM27BgKHtPKjer3GL3r4EwPRS0%3D)_**

Here's why this matters more than you might think.

When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line.

Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run -- and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer.

The first lawful suppressor transfer without NFA registration since 1934.
| Friend, **Gun owners have waited 92 years for this.** At 12:01 this morning, I participated in the first lawful suppressor transfers since 1934 that did not require registration under the National Firearms Act. | [ ](https://5krvn9r6.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fcontact.brandonherreraforcongress.com%2Fl%2F6fI53a1vdu7637OWRF387YCA%2FUmw9xTxco4NlkMMkh892Oghw%2FYza66jX7eznJpmbTL03AFQ/1/010f019ffae9684c-d02b160d-9484-4f63-84cf-4a948b0156cd-000000/wsWoWOvBLsgea6IMZFySpe95BhY=258)
---
Gun Owners of America, Silencer Shop, Texas State Representative Wes Virdell, and I notified the Department of Justice and ATF in advance that we intended to complete these transfers. ATF did not object, and we proceeded in accordance with all other applicable federal and state laws.
GOA helped eliminate the federal tax on suppressors and short-barreled firearms through President Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill. Then, we took the fight to court and won an order blocking ATF enforcement of the unconstitutional registration requirements.
I'm proud to once again stand with our 2A allies at the tip of the spear, fighting for gun owners and the constitutional rights of every American.
**This is what it looks like when we stop merely talking about defending the Second Amendment and start winning.**
Now, I need your help to take that fight to Congress.

subject: This deadline is different. Can I explain?

body:
On August 19th our campaign will face our final FEC deadline before our primary election.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=8280%2E582294%2Ecz-BVz)
I’m reaching out personally, because next Wednesday — August 19th — our campaign will face **our final FEC deadline before New Hampshire’s primary election.**
**[If you’re in a position to help our campaign in a major way by chipping in your first $5 before this major deadline, it’d mean so much to me.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260813_1.yW2Pwj&refcode=em20260813-1&t=2&akid=8280%2E582294%2Ecz-BVz)**
Look, this deadline is different from our usual monthly and quarterly deadlines I’ve emailed you about before. And I want to tell you exactly why:
Next Wednesday’s deadline marks the LAST time we’ll report our fundraising to the FEC before the primary election. That means it’s our LAST chance to prove we can defeat the MAGA billionaires who are dumping money into this race to try to buy the Granite State’s Senate seat.
It’s no exaggeration to say this is the biggest test our campaign has faced so far. And our ability to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue and flip control of the Senate will come down to whether we can raise enough to build a winning campaign.
**We need to take this opportunity to show the size and strength of this grassroots team, so I’m humbly asking:**
**[Please, rush a donation of any amount right now so we can reach our fundraising goal before next Wednesday’s deadline and prove that our campaign is stronger than ever.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260813_1.yW2Pwj&refcode=em20260813-1&t=3&akid=8280%2E582294%2Ecz-BVz)**
Right now Republicans are outspending us at a ratio of 3 to 1. They’re counting on us to be intimidated by their spending; they believe that flooding the airwaves will discourage our campaign from moving forward.
This FEC deadline is our final opportunity before the primary for us to show that we have the support needed to win here in New Hampshire.
With your help our FEC report will prove that we have the support of everyday folks like you. Together we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale.
**[So, what do you say? Will you step up for the first time to help us defend New Hampshire and flip the Senate blue?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260813_1.yW2Pwj&refcode=em20260813-1&t=4&akid=8280%2E582294%2Ecz-BVz)**

Chris Pappas

---
| | The July CPI landed this morning exactly on consensus: the Consumer Price Index rose 0.1% for the month, pulling annual inflation down to 3.4% from 3.5% in June, with core easing to 2.5% year-over-year. **Every headline figure matched the Dow Jones forecast almost exactly, and inflation has now eased for two consecutive months from the 4.2% peak in May.** Stock futures rose and Treasury yields pulled back on the release.
---
| | For your portfolio, the report answers the question the market had asked for weeks: was the Iran energy shock a spiral or a contained spike? The trajectory now tells the story clearly. Inflation bottomed near 2.4% in winter, accelerated for three months as the US-Iran conflict disrupted energy shipping, peaked at 4.2% in May, and has retraced two months lower to 3.4%. **This is best read as recovery from a shock, not a resumption of the pre-war disinflation trend.** For the American investor at or near retirement, the confirmed peak-and-retrace is more reassuring than any single month’s figure: a market that feared a spiral now has two months of evidence it is fading. But the level still matters — at 3.4%, inflation runs above target and above the 3.2% pace of wages. The acute risk has diminished; the chronic above-target problem persists. Constructive for risk assets near-term, but not a return to the low-inflation regime that preceded the war.

subject: Announcing "New Energy for Rhode Island"

body:
| |
---
Hi friend, I have incredibly exciting news. **This afternoon, I will be releasing my comprehensive energy plan, “New Energy for Rhode Island: Putting the Power Back in Our Hands.”** The 17-page detailed plan outlines the key legislative and administrative strategies our state needs to address rising utility costs, climate change, and corporate influence over the state’s energy system.
---
|
---
We are experiencing a real energy affordability crisis right now, and Rhode Islanders need leaders who have clear solutions to address this. Governor McKee has repeatedly attempted to roll back energy efficiency programs and renewable energy priorities under the guise of ‘saving ratepayers money.’ In reality, these rollbacks only protect the utility’s short-term profits and hurt Rhode Islanders in the long run.
---
_**"New Energy for Rhode Island" addresses the energy crisis holistically, outlining the real solutions to stabilizing electricity rates and creating an affordable, reliable, clean energy future.**_
---
Rhode Island has incredible experts, legislators, and advocates who have been leading the way on energy issues. I am proud that many of these leaders have already signed on to the plan, including Representatives Jennifer Boylan, Terri Cortvriend, Rebecca Kislak, Michelle McGaw, Brandon Potter, June Speakman, and Teresa Tanzi; Senator Alana DiMario; Climate Action Rhode Island, with more to be announced. My commitment is to elevate and amplify this expertise, leverage my deep understanding of how to make government work, and collaboratively implement real solutions to these challenges. Rhode Islanders are hurting now. Energy bills are soaring now. The climate crisis is happening now. We do not have time to wait for our statewide leaders to find the energy to make change. We need leaders equipped with the vision and drive to fight for Rhode Islanders _now_. I am tired of politicians making big empty promises. I will come into office with a plan, a team, and a to-do list.
---
_**But in order to implement this plan, I need your help winning the primary that is less than a month away. If you can chip in even $25 today, you can help create a brighter future for all Rhode Islanders.**_
---

clean_body: | | Hi friend, I have incredibly exciting news. This afternoon, I will be releasing my comprehensive energy plan, “New Energy for Rhode Island: Putting the Power Back in Our Hands.” The 17-page detailed plan outlines the key legislative and administrative strategies our state needs to address rising utility costs, climate change, and corporate influence over the state’s energy system. | We are experiencing a real energy affordability crisis right now, and Rhode Islanders need leaders who have clear solutions to address this. Governor McKee has repeatedly attempted to roll back energy efficiency programs and renewable energy priorities under the guise of ‘saving ratepayers money.’ In reality, these rollbacks only protect the utility’s short-term profits and hurt Rhode Islanders in the long run. "New Energy for Rhode Island" addresses the energy crisis holistically, outlining the real solutions to stabilizing electricity rates and creating an affordable, reliable, clean energy future. Rhode Island has incredible experts, legislators, and advocates who have been leading the way on energy issues. I am proud that many of these leaders have already signed on to the plan, including Representatives Jennifer Boylan, Terri Cortvriend, Rebecca Kislak, Michelle McGaw, Brandon Potter, June Speakman, and Teresa Tanzi; Senator Alana DiMario; Climate Action Rhode Island, with more to be announced. My commitment is to elevate and amplify this expertise, leverage my deep understanding of how to make government work, and collaboratively implement real solutions to these challenges. Rhode Islanders are hurting now. Energy bills are soaring now. The climate crisis is happening now. We do not have time to wait for our statewide leaders to find the energy to make change. We need leaders equipped with the vision and drive to fight for Rhode Islanders now. I am tired of politicians making big empty promises. I will come into office with a plan, a team, and a to-do list. But in order to implement this plan, I need your help winning the primary that is less than a month away. If you can chip in even $25 today, you can help create a brighter future for all Rhode Islanders. I cannot wait to share this plan with you, and to get to work on Day 1 as your next Lieutenant Governor, fighting to put the power back in your hands. | That's not something a Speaker of the House says. That's something you hear from the yard boss of a prison gang -- the guy who decides who gets protection and who doesn't, no matter what they've done.
And here's the thing about Mike Johnson's gang: There's no line you can cross to get kicked out. He's backing Brandon Herrera -- an avowed Neo-Nazi who cosplays in SS uniforms and jokes about school shooting victims -- for a US House seat. In Mike Johnson's gang, even being a Neo-Nazi doesn't get your protection revoked. It just gets you a nomination.
That's who Mike Johnson runs cover for. Not the families in this district drowning in medical bills. Not the people locked up and abused at Winn Correction Center down the road from me. His protection is reserved for the people who help keep him in power -- donors, extremists, and Donald Trump himself -- no matter what they've done to earn it.
I'm Conrad Cable, and I'm a farmer. Where I come from, you don't run protection for people like that. You run them off your land.
Mike Johnson has turned the Speaker's office into exactly what he bragged about: a protection racket for the worst people in his party, at the expense of everyone else. This district doesn't need a prison boss. It needs someone who actually answers to the people who live here.

Right now MAGA is on the cusp of what experts are terming an 'extinction level event' in the upcoming 2026 Midterm Election.
Nowhere is this more evident than in red state North Carolina where polls show that Democrat Roy Cooper is on track to flip the state's long GOP held US Senate Seat.
Backed into a corner, MAGA is pulling out all stops to try to salvage control over this seat. This week news broke that the North Carolina State House has passed a bill to allow their far-right State Supreme Court to remove all Democratic judges in the state:
---

This matters because right now Democratic judges are the only thing standing in the way of undemocratic coup attempts in red states across the nation, including North Carolina.
If Democratic judges across North Carolina are removed, MAGA will be able to throw out votes, undermine a potential (and near inevitable) Roy Cooper victory, and ensure that the GOPholds onto this critical US Senate seat. A judicial coup.
Now, we need to shoot straight with you. In 2022, Democrats lost our majority on the North Carolina State Supreme Court. Today Republicans hold a 5-2 majority on this court.
In November, one of the last two remaining Democratic justices on the court, Anita Earls, is up for reelection. MAGA hopes to unseat her. If they defeat her, their majority becomes 6-1.
If we win, the GOP majority stays 5-2, it won't mean much in the short term. However, three Republican justices are up for their reelection in 2028 and if we hold onto this seat, we have an opportunity to flip that court to a 5-2 Democratic majority.
In the short term, MAGA has us dead to rights in North Carolina. But in the long term we can take this court back. The very reason why Defend our Courts was founded was so that we could compete with the right's multi-decade strategy of court capture and that's why we are taking on this fight.
We can recapture North Carolina's Supreme Court by 2028 but only if we show resolve and fight battles focused on the long term like the one to defend NC Democratic Supreme Court Justice Anita Earls in 2026. clean_body: News is breaking that Republicans will do the unthinkable to try to stop a Democrat from winning North Carolina’s US Senate Seat. Right now they have us dead to rights but it doesn’t have to stay that | | | | | == | Peter, Right now MAGA is on the cusp of what experts are terming an 'extinction level event' in the upcoming 2026 Midterm Election. Nowhere is this more evident than in red state North Carolina where polls show that Democrat Roy Cooper is on track to flip the state's long GOP held US Senate Seat. Backed into a corner, MAGA is pulling out all stops to try to salvage control over this seat. This week news broke that the North Carolina State House has passed a bill to allow their far-right State Supreme Court to remove all Democratic judges in the state: | == This matters because right now Democratic judges are the only thing standing in the way of undemocratic coup attempts in red states across the nation, including North Carolina. If Democratic judges across North Carolina are removed, MAGA will be able to throw out votes, undermine a potential (and near inevitable) Roy Cooper victory, and ensure that the GOPholds onto this critical US Senate seat. A judicial coup. Now, we need to shoot straight with you. In 2022, Democrats lost our majority on the North Carolina State Supreme Court. Today Republicans hold a 5-2 majority on this court. In November, one of the last two remaining Democratic justices on the court, Anita Earls, is up for reelection. MAGA hopes to unseat her. If they defeat her, their majority becomes 6-1. If we win, the GOP majority stays 5-2, it won't mean much in the short term. However, three Republican justices are up for their reelection in 2028 and if we hold onto this seat, we have an opportunity to flip that court to a 5-2 Democratic majority. In the short term, MAGA has us dead to rights in North Carolina. But in the long term we can take this court back. The very reason why Defend our Courts was founded was so that we could compete with the right's multi-decade strategy of court capture and that's why we are taking on this fight. We can recapture North Carolina's Supreme Court by 2028 but only if we show resolve and fight battles focused on the long term like the one to defend NC Democratic Supreme Court Justice Anita Earls in 2026. == | | | == | == | == | | | == | == | == | | | | == | Thank you for showing resolve in the face of short term defeats. body:
#

Hey there,
It’s Scott Kelly — Mark Kelly’s twin brother (also an astronaut!).
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260813-1-b&refcode2=11723.3935704.Q0ozFk&t=1&akid=11723%2E3935704%2EQ0ozFk)_(I'm the one on the right)_
I know Mark and Gabby pretty well, better than most. To know them is to know one thing: **_Don’t ever — not even for one moment — underestimate them._**
On January 8, 2011, I was commanding the International Space Station (ISS) when Gabby was shot at a constituent event. It rocked our family forever.
Throughout the next few weeks, I called Mark every day on the phone as he updated me on Gabby’s condition. I traveled to see them immediately after landing.
I am in awe of Gabby. It’s now been fifteen years since that terrible day, but Gabby hasn’t stopped fighting — not only for herself, but for our families across the country.
But the truth is, not everybody likes that. That’s exactly why the NRA is working so hard to attack Gabby and the incredible work she’s accomplished at GIFFORDS.
It’s never easy watching your family get attacked, but I’m so grateful to know you have their back. Together, you have helped them stand up to the gun lobby and pass more than 820 gun safety laws. That’s no small feat.
**But as the attacks ramp up ahead of the midterm elections, Gabby can’t win this fight alone. So I have a humble request:**
[**Will you please chip in $5 to stand with Gabby? GIFFORDS PAC is working to reach undecided voters and take on the gun lobby’s influence in our politics, but she needs your help >>**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260813-1-b&amount=%245&t=2&akid=11723%2E3935704%2EQ0ozFk)

clean_body: | | | | Friends, I want to take a moment to lay out exactly where this race stands and what it’s going to take to win in November. Recently, a third race rater That is a significant shift and confirms what we have known from the start: we CAN and WILL win this! It is going to be a hard fight. Our district is one of the most competitive races in the country and is key to winning back Democratic control of the House. And the rest of the country is taking notice. recently put our race at the center of the battle for control of the House, making the stakes clear: “If Democrats flip it, they're likely on the path to taking the gavel.” also highlighted just how competitive this race has become and how vulnerable Mike Lawler is heading into November. Our victory is not guaranteed, but it is within reach. NY-17 is a true purple district, with nearly 30% of voters registered as Unaffiliated or Independent. We cannot win with registered Democrats alone. That is exactly why we have spent the last year building a coalition of Democrats, Republicans, and Independents who are fed up with Washington corruption, partisanship, and career politicians who put their political survival over the people they serve. And Mike Lawler represents exactly the kind of politics people are tired of — calling himself a moderate but voting with Donald Trump 100% of the time. The coalition we are building is special. What brings us together is something bigger than party: it’s about our country, our values, and the future we are fighting for. With our democracy, our freedom, and the American Dream on the line, the stakes are simply too high to sit this one out. We have real work ahead. Over the next three months, we need to knock on every door, reach every persuadable voter, close the fundraising gap, and build the biggest volunteer operation this district has ever seen. Mike Lawler may have the advantage of incumbency and a war chest funded by Elon Musk and corporate PACs, but we have a relentless team ready to fight and win for this district. I have spoken with great pride about the many historic accomplishments of this Administration, and I have relished holding the liberal media accountable and ensuring the American people hear the truth about President Trump’s successes. “Being a mother and welcoming a new baby while working in one of the most demanding jobs in the world has been the most rewarding yet challenging season of my life, to say the least. The truth is since returning to the White House after the birth of my daughter, I have felt in my heart that I cannot be the best mom my two young children deserve while devoting the constant time, energy, and attention required of the White House Press Secretary — and that is why I have ultimately made the bittersweet decision to depart the White House and embark on a new chapter in my life. “President Trump has asked me to continue serving as a top advisor to him on the outside, and I will always remain a vocal advocate for MAGA and the Republican Party. “Our country is facing an existential threat from an increasingly extremist Democrat Party that seeks to destroy everything great about America, and I believe it is incumbent upon all of us who care about this country to fight back against that threat. My fight is entering a new phase, but it is far from over. “Thank you again to the President, the First Lady, and the entire Trump family for your kindness and generosity over the years. Thank you to our amazing Chief of Staff Susie Wiles for empowering me since the day she hired me on the campaign, and to the President’s cabinet, my staff, colleagues, and friends at the White House who work so hard on behalf of our nation. It has been a privilege to serve alongside so many accomplished and impressive people, and I look forward to cheering them on over the next two and a half years. “And of course, thank you most especially to my loving and supportive husband and family for the sacrifices they made for me to serve in this role. ♥️🇺🇸” Karoline will go down in history as the greatest White House Press Secretary of all time. She deserves to know how much the American people love her. Will you help us? Peter, I went back and forth on if I should send you this or not. Not because I didn't know what to say, but because I knew how much it would hurt to say it. It’s difficult to admit that I can't do this alone. [**There's so much weighing on me right now, and finding the right words feels impossible. But I'm trusting these words will reach you the way they need to.**](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/NSFd7lzvVWTYTWCftFc93zrwlkwQUJ67k6caNm6ghn1yG_TekVH4gTbkBAL2jUriDS3GxnfFxgCr5_eOeLZqrLhLXo0p6L1VlTyt7luNfGi7P0pk2zzwY6FqBy8z7BVDqYTSI1hojjM0WtdergfZljdSZD32EqXYmHePUB3YpNWrzR7IkKSfRaNTbYcXbRlDDOuCjzmAdVrOAqTg--Gvxr6uAsJ9z1cNIIaFpG27QpUbrGAZbtUy6_k7AulR1JNEm3IMmaMjN1CNvXYBcdUjawCjxKiXIyvB7tO0Ifjmzax_AI7a9Uz2V48EfQvf8TEnfRwqbroCR5GZTIPSBs6ZZ3g6mhvn-1SqVbKNlcCa4xTb7QGNmqtJS1T6V_1Phmb58At2sjQa-QTbrECXG6bX_DcN_OVULB6xEJy9_55tn3Ohm7qk3MthD0i_UT9Pzlnp7lyINQPJFUXrLDxplJwjXbE4nahvx9sMEn4lkRjHFop7JNnN-rDeuVHoBChTqrbrIDBNyZlLAJccHT_tP9-L-UJnr-pHmxV9vZSpDJarWCTyaLkaZ1_wJ801q58LBePoH3N85hiBqX9HsLf2nu7Eip-ZWap3TmVKYbPY9p8cpxkSQ-8RkPLvb3qj5E39zfRE17sDAduqjhCa-bYckFiqdovOpujKhqmNWd3zEZuShAzDnRgqefpZk4OAb4w2ODopYwLAjNS8cdCD9KbJtZcyv9rHYm3z1YbA7rhaC9ff7uc4i7B-vxucxPk2WxxXQUgI3so_VBqbriLFCSEbwnA7diirSN4k1euW_AUmNDH0bhnrQdc/V10uvt83I_ocZ1hbq-cAO9WUGC0YtBqy/23) It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. I didn't come to Washington because I love asking true patriots like you for money. I didn't run for Congress at 29 years old to become the youngest House Republican so I could spend my nights begging for donations. I came because my kids deserve to grow up in a better America than I grew up in — and right now, that's not guaranteed. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father Almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. I refuse to look my kids in the eye someday and tell them I gave up when it mattered most. [**That's why I'm still here. That's why I keep sending these messages.**](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/9UcTBsNLi4bmcQiL5BxjIpYhJWK04bjjR8ttunluJjKLjedaO2UJ-g_8GXtWQn1XimAXkWPiY7XLB7HZvT48oCzztY9UHqhvMd6Z0f0YSkbmzLzvC3sud3VKiiDhqrxoLSgpdheMqFAJT2p8CTIVf74TlXQvFqImMEwkHCErSyNUX_j-iVyQd66N7NSazlIOqe1bb2RxK3d80zQAPgU3XvyBRPnYaz4YTcPlWOoqzmhfNZtdIROaxeY4tv4jL-CYDYGlIrjNsXjCMxATDZ-w-7kXh_vZ9qLdpYMh2BNHXvUd6p90V8oA6Xcda1fUCjEYIgRnav1_5rxtDOYkXqnEzoAdPMkMOqyQjtCWHABV5M3uK52MpB1tdPR9Ec1v_nZRZOlJWrojbWQ_jyDUcm_uoAV-JxielOvh11hySVv28Yv91r7fSpXqcW2cA60DaC6s18Qm9D9pXbWe9yteY9ZKAYN03aJG7EJ60wJD3NCxgxZVnJ4VbmHeandY4gwDaAQ0r0x4-lMtIEbZ7CLFda29Tw_1DkJepstrmVpWG4Y7MZaLrraFP-8vibySDDFYWdvrp-uCJsnuykmQaLm7pMgfwFPSvK2PgqKuYAEO85QeTxL4zF9Ma4EMwnavFlM7N7-C_KG44OTHMtc5EXcrdbnkbNM15CAI9mZX-J_ZtCTofkn_C5eMdqn7yzyQ00drLYog6nNoJv9zmNWba3zlr9P9oxK6uFJqIcK4g-8bSnga4Y6UlXbzhMnXfBeh9eMAdDJzhvsYpb03i9vWkYKp55c9ZIIP1-ubfn7W4NqmFpj1Y5Iu1rE/WMTNunNYUzsvt1T7WwcPhlDxy3ufgv6c/23) Because nothing — I repeat — nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country. The left hates you. They hate your vote. They hate MAGA for putting America First. And they will do anything — lie, cheat, steal, destroy — to ensure your children inherit a country you won't even recognize. Peter, today I'll make the same promise to you that I've made to myself, to my wife, and to my children: As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Not the attacks. Not the exhaustion. Not the constant pressure to give up and go home. Believe me, I'm not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Texting and emailing you like this is the last thing I thought I'd have to do when I ran for Congress. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction, and God has put it on my heart to fight with all that I have — even when that means swallowing my pride and asking for help. [**Please, will you take just 1 minute out of your busy schedule to help me continue my fight?**](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/CXXDYy3RzT-BxKco71MaxET9mXA2g_Z5Rxi9m1LftlLKi_rSivTpI0YH2uK9rXjPpxln_H9Ibd3V9X9UoPhsvY2WgglUMbe1MIZYBXg9484usZlQpE4f0nNtmgyHsF0zTOiuAc98aTQ7U8M7IQCnn1fdWVZvONyhV62mhH-uxFc_qWox7_rEZ0lYWyoxHCeWytkF1KhkwwEvaq05aIS104Il--wNHzOdhfRHxiel4mnRhPLOi8Kw0e9usuUKMSs4e2UnVRIT7KVOQiuB7oNj7TE8nmZKnL53KHE3hhXinT44hie-0SqEXOSaLU7IBz38fVOORgjSSRlqrf1rsusAAab1d25OQjrupcHCNx-qD1ndh02IMdgnElp4MT2q2Izyy4IIqh5ISJMKHIiLc3_p7CMUo7Kg8QV1vBzGSi--vYnTiAEbh5t0vgpBQRchE8Bl_ZNDOku8TQYMy_NF3iE8ibMsNHlpuL-We7I9437a3BJ1jFABvCKCslJYAwToEyL90itcbe4bAr_qQZfWN0wNvRSJ-WMqZnEXJuoGx-h47PPTdzjuX9I1y1Ms_V3S3YIGCxTmyv8METOGhH9RDWjGj642hwh2oPoUUp2cmMDPaa1IuyFFKoqOm5zVhJoSn-UjWI_tze4xvRWdl5iZJ22b9nm0JDnOiJ93TqbaJTmmmPFneoZZTDMRqz5k8tk5MDjgecS9XEzgFd60FqgqgpFRqDQEYPsN0K_-rRf7k75acaA-mAQRIqPi2KgatxRkKdY0_YwN3sujQwcUDekmqBdvyihiFBXjW-zdRpKJHxnaHBCX8W8/eQ86PE2PCB_LrYcpwRy0BXsHuMGZ2fan/23) This is more than a polite request. This is now a final plea for your support. Sincerely, Congressman Brandon Gill (R) TX-26
