Expropriations that taught every serious operator in the world to stay away. By the time sanctions tightened in 2019, production had already fallen to about a million barrels a day. In June 2020 it bottomed at 337,000 barrels per day -- roughly nine percent of the 1970 peak. Nine percent. In a country sitting on 1.36 trillion barrels of oil in place in the Orinoco Belt alone. The recovery since January is real and it is measurable. OPEC secondary sources put June 2026 output just above one million barrels per day, a 17.6 percent increase over 2025. PDVSA reported July production at 1.2 million. Exports ran 1.16 million barrels per day in July, and -- this is the number that matters for American drivers -- cargoes to the United States hit roughly 786,000 barrels per day, the highest level since early 2019. On one block, Aldyl went from 500 barrels a day to 20,000 in the time it would take a megaproject to complete a feasibility study. | | ---|---|--- ALDYL has integrated the latest technology available including STARLINK If even a third of the country's near-term recovery follows that template, the $100 billion figure is off by an order of magnitude on the portion that matters most -- the portion that determines whether Venezuelan crude is flowing to Gulf Coast refineries in 2028 or in 2038. That is not a rounding error in a forecast. That is the difference between a hemispheric energy strategy that works and one that stays on a whiteboard. The consensus was built by watching the old model fail. It has not yet priced in a new one. Arostegui puts it less diplomatically. " People said Venezuela would take a decade. We did forty times our production in under two years, on one block. The decade estimate was never about geology. It was about governance." The hemispheric case The strategic logic of all this is straightforward, and it is exactly the logic Trump, Rubio, and Wright have been articulating since January. Every barrel that comes out of the Orinoco is a barrel that does not have to come from the Persian Gulf, does not have to transit a strait that Iran periodically threatens to close, and does not have to be bought from a regime that funds people trying to kill Americans. It is a barrel produced roughly 2,000 miles from Gulf Coast refineries that were literally designed to process Venezuelan heavy crude and have been running below their optimal slate for years. Affordable energy independence for the Western Hemisphere is not a slogan. It is an achievable engineering and capital allocation problem, and the constraint was never geology. Venezuela has the oil. The constraint was governance, and the governance changed in January. Arostegui frames the ambition in terms of what this country used to be rather than what it has been. " This country produced almost four million barrels a day. That capacity did not disappear -- the geology is still there, the fields are still there. What was missing was the will to invest and a government that wanted the investment. Every barrel we bring back is a barrel the hemisphere does not have to buy from people who do not wish it well." Rodriguez wants production up. Trump wants production up. Rubio wants production up. Companies like Aldyl are the mechanism by which that shared goal turns into barrels -- not through another twenty-year megaproject announcement, but through technology applied hard to acreage everyone else wrote off. The Faja is loud again. Anyone who thinks that happened by accident wasn't paying attention on January 3. You're currently a free subscriber to . Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 affordable housing units and push for universal childcare for working families.

**I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make lives better for all Wisconsinites.**

Wisconsin is one of the most competitive states in the country. Every one of our last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point.

And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism.

Jamie is a successful farmer from rural Louisiana who farms the same land his grandfather worked as a sharecropper. When he wins he will be the first Black man elected to US Senate in Louisiana history.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

# News From the Road
---
|
---
I appreciated the opportunity to spend time in North Sioux City for a town hall and hear directly from people in Union County. One issue that came up repeatedly was access to healthcare and the challenges communities are facing as it becomes harder to recruit and retain healthcare professionals.
South Dakota already has programs designed to strengthen our rural healthcare workforce, but we need to be willing to look at where those programs are falling short and what else our communities need. That includes addressing issues like affordable housing that can make it difficult for healthcare professionals to put down roots in the communities they serve. No matter where you live in South Dakota, you should be able to access quality healthcare close to home.
---

Small businesses are a big part of what keeps South Dakota communities strong. They create jobs, keep our main streets open, and give people the opportunity to build something of their own. But right now, small businesses, especially in rural South Dakota, are facing enough challenges without the federal government putting up additional roadblocks.
The Trump Administration has dramatically reduced the capacity of the Small Business Administration (SBA). According to the SBA, it cut its workforce by more than 50% in 2025, reduced its operating budget by 33%, terminated or paused more than 120 contracts, and consolidated nearly half of its leases.
The Administration says these cuts will reduce waste, fraud and abuse and make the agency more efficient. But what looks good on a spreadsheet in Washington doesn’t always work on Main Street in South Dakota.

| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.m.rightnationalerts.com/s/c/OLwXFvL7pDoTWjVxZ9fB6d8tQAuHBCug8P_SRNPb2YkVGljUZ8dBX_P6c0yb4a8Q0qv_9CzYSutXHX69s4TJFxAFyUUknRJqKIwWjMHrihd7kpIEYWguAiwbhzR0ohbpumGK9gHGQJAg6XgpXVhG4db4J7w3vIRT-_2vV8D3Xu1c_KIXJ96uOOvoKvcLrJwGhib1jPDXF8MWsiuoI6NztjMivvjR7C2NwqobeNXyV6j_ETD6TkdSG99KxdgykRJMMdya0KJxMBeXGIa_kNpdzJggo2Ui7ej_sNxIxZnh1gO8JibM4d9KJAdeXPDfHF9M2ZPuBxeCijCxjItRy4sQwQC3YiDegbghotCnNTTgk_5sh_oULrn-Qz67jHtvTg_S98USVq88VaGqdEXdIExJ6yIz8-3wGz-dsGsiUM1S95R-OXD7sR6V5uY6LiWfOFvhNOzYOT70_qqdyHgXF3Lo989VPSi80N2Mc3uVFE0Z3uj1snv_bUoNlcEve_Rfu-H14thK40Y3v0-o5-8Gh1jSixYajrwBlPgdooI7wwzxNm8CuTD69IYjGkNQ8vSFGFf-GhKSR4dT6jZm0WJWErJPeVaX2WcK6R1LtojG-HExLQhU3i-ZV8BgBWn5VQnWVvyqieAO41CMZmG7KCqsyBZ0syfbPP5UpZ1K366c_sml0Y0QoA8TDvWSvlyIwlzbyW8d0S_RhP3wCynnHXCYarydWqaKvU-BY78gCe2IgWJk8UtVSVMpu4gGzb2oW8XND_8Sr4l6PoI/d4Bl_wg2klWijl3p_EWRm7WiXvRk-hfd/23)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America, Kirk Cameron | | | BRAVE For Good 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301 ${Gears.unsubscribe\(\})

subject: Trump is going to destroy the United States Navy if we don’t stop him
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
The USS Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group has been deployed for nearly nine months. They’ve been at sea for 200 days straight without a port call.
#
Peter, this is Rick Hegdahl. I’m the Veteran Organizer here at VoteVets, and a Navy Veteran with multiple wartime deployments under my belt.
I need you to hear about what Trump is putting our Sailors and Marines through right now.
The USS Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group has been deployed for nearly nine months. They’ve been at sea for 200 days straight without a port call, which is the longest I’ve ever heard about. They’re dealing with food shortages, water contamination, moldy showers, broken toilets, dead laundry facilities — even the basics like soap and toothpaste are in short supply.
It’s hard to imagine if you didn’t serve in the Navy, but try: You’re sleeping in a berth alongside a handful of other crew every single night. Close quarters. You’re eating each of your meals in the galley, at best — at worst it’s MREs at battle stations. And on this tour, you’re at war. You’re constantly at battle stations.
These sailors are exhausted. They haven’t had a break in 200 days. They miss home. We’re seeing more and more reports of crew trying to go overboard — and at least one succeeding. And it’s important to make something clear right now: This isn’t their fault. This goes straight to the top, because it’s a failure of leadership.
Hegseth and Trump talk about lethality, but they are destroying the finest and most powerful Navy in the history of warfare. It’s appalling, and it’s exactly what we’ve come to expect. They are pushing these men and women to the brink, and past it.
We knew this was coming when Trump took office. We tried our hardest to stop it. These Sailors and Marines are facing the worst situations imaginable, and it’s on us to have their back.

One of America’s most breathtaking national parks is being bulldozed right now. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137188171/639924546/1916234632?source=email&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fjane-bax-email-ja%3Frefcode%3Dea.cd7c745c-5197-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30%26ms%3Dea.cd7c745c-5197-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&refcode=ea.cd7c745c-5197-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ms=ea.cd7c745c-5197-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkN2M3NDVjLTUxOTctZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMGQzYTExZmEzMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=UoCtYJeQ2oBHONLapkdqmWGrG9-B5QQ39t-4nhwpTyc=&emci=8e312856-5197-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=cd7c745c-5197-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=4823105)
Source: Center for Biological Diversity, Natalie Newman **Federal contractors authorized by Customs and Border Protection recently began bulldozing miles of sensitive habitat near Santa Elena Canyon, one of the most treasured corners of Big Bend National Park, as part of Donald Trump's plan to build new border barriers, paved roads, and other invasive infrastructure straight through this wild landscape.** Nearly a million acres of desert, mountains, and canyon country stretch along the Rio Grande here. It is the kind of place that reminds you just how extraordinary — and fragile — our natural world can be. But rather than protecting what makes our country so special, this administration is fast-tracking construction through it. Source: Center for Biological Diversity, Natalie Newman Federal contractors authorized by Customs and Border Protection recently began bulldozing miles of sensitive habitat near Santa Elena Canyon, one of the most treasured corners of Big Bend National Park, as part of Donald Trump's plan to build new border barriers, paved roads, and other invasive infrastructure straight through this wild landscape. Nearly a million acres of desert, mountains, and canyon country stretch along the Rio Grande here. It is the kind of place that reminds you just how extraordinary — and fragile — our natural world can be. But rather than protecting what makes our country so special, this administration is fast-tracking construction through it. The National Parks Conservation Association is even warning that this construction could inflict irreparable damage — not just to Big Bend, but to Texas's state parks, the iconic wildlife that calls this place home, and the tight-knit gateway communities that depend on this land. | What Trump doesn't seem to understand is that our national parks belong to all of us. It’s where we reconnect with the natural world — where we remember what’s worth protecting in the first place. They hold our memories, our family trips, our photographs, and those rare moments where we can stand somewhere beautiful and simply feel awe. To bulldoze these wild landscapes, in service of Trump's border wall ambitions, is a betrayal of that connection. And here's what makes this especially hard to accept: the very ruggedness Trump is destroying already sees fewer unauthorized crossings than almost anywhere else. We'd be destroying something rare and irreplaceable to "fix" something that isn't even broken. That’s why opposition to this construction stretches well beyond the climate movement. | | | | | | Peter,
Your utility bills keep going up. And they’re about to go up again.
PPL Electric is raising residential rates nearly 5% in July. Natural gas rates are climbing another 7% in August. And the energy auctions that set future prices just hit record highs — meaning even more increases are on the way.
Here’s Stacy’s plan:
⚡ **Cut hidden taxes on your electric bill:** Pennsylvania charges a gross receipts tax on utilities that gets passed directly to consumers. Eliminating it would lower bills by 15–25% immediately
🏭 **Fast-track new power generation:** Cut through the red tape so new natural gas plants can come online faster and meet the growing demand from data centers
⛽ **Unleash Pennsylvania’s natural gas:** We sit on one of the largest reserves in the world but pay more for energy than we should because Harrisburg keeps getting in the way
💰 **Make data centers pay their own way:** Developers should bring their own energy and enter community benefit agreements so your community benefits, not just big tech
And Shapiro?
He sued the grid operator. He threatened to pull Pennsylvania off the grid. He hasn’t taken a public position on cutting the gross receipts tax. And he’s spent more time on press conferences about the problem than actually solving it.
Press conferences don’t lower your electric bill. Real plans do.
– Team Garrity

A never-before-released 911 call log from the Bexley Police Department, obtained by Loomer Unleashed, reveals new details about the 2019 domestic disturbance at the home of Ohio Democrat gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton. Records show it was Acton's own daughter who called 911 to report that her mother had been "drinking and throwing things and breaking glass."
LOOMER UNLEASHED is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider a paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..01QpzW6oHfuZ_Oxt39bBb_sOjOi-cazHIb-6B-5cu3k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=211091346)
The incident occurred while Acton was serving as Director of the Ohio Department of Health, the same position she used months later to help impose statewide COVID lockdowns, business closures, and school restrictions on nearly 12 million Ohioans under then-Governor Mike DeWine. Acton is now the Democrat nominee for governor of Ohio, facing Republican Vivek Ramaswamy, and she is attempting to sell voters on her judgment and leadership under pressure.
The Bexley Police Department call log for Call Number 19-10872, dated August 17, 2019, shows a 911 call placed at 2145 hours. clean_body: I received a heartbreaking message I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Peter, I received a heartbreaking message from Tyler Tew, a J6 patriot in desperate need of help, and wanted to pass it along. Tyler was a commercial pilot for 14 years... until Joe Biden 's TSA revoked his commercial pilot's license for "suspicion of terrorism" without even being charged with a crime. As a result of his lost pilot's salary, Tyler's family business is now in bankruptcy, and he, his wife, and their four kids are in desperate need of your support. I promised Tyler Stand in the Gap could help raise the funds he needs to get his company back on track, and Peter, Tyler's message absolutely broke my heart, and I'd like you to read it if you have a moment: My name is Tyler Tew. I was a commercial airline pilot for 14 years. I flew for SkyWest as a Captain and then Allegiant. I graduated from Utah State with an aviation degree and built my entire life around flying. I went to Washington on January 6 after being invited by friends. After President Trump's speech, I went to the Capitol. What I saw with my own eyes did not match what the news reported. On March 26, 2021, the TSA revoked my commercial pilot 's license for "suspicion of terrorism" and being a threat to the national airspace -- before I was ever charged with a crime and before any FBI interview.I spent $40,000 in legal fees. In June 2021, Allegiant fired me. Without my W-2 income, I could no longer sustain the construction company my wife and I owned. It is now in bankruptcy. We have four children. I now work 6-7 days a week in construction just to survive. I'm hoping Stand in the Gap can help us raise $25,000 to stabilize our family and our company during this bankruptcy and help us recover from the financial destruction caused by the sudden end of my aviation career. We have nowhere else to turn. Thank you for anything you can do. -- Tyler Tew Tyler's story is why we started our Fund Their Futures fundraising program, Peter. President Trump's pardons gave these patriots back their freedom... but that did NOT give them their lives, careers, businesses, or homes back. Tyler did everything right for decades... building a wonderful career, a small business, and a loving family. It all ended WITHOUT due process ... simply because the Far-Left wanted to punish him for supporting President Trump. Your gift today will give Tyler and his family breathing room. It'll help stabilize their company and help them keep a roof over their heads. Stand with the Gap exists specifically for moments like this... to when the legal fight is over, but the fight to survive has just begun. Too often, Stand in the Gap is the for the men and women who faced political persecution and financial ruin after January 6. We exist to share the burden and make it lighter ... and your generosity is quite literally the difference between families like Tyler's losing everything. That's why I hope you'll step forward, Peter. Even just a few dollars could make a critical difference. Thank you so much for helping them out. Thirty-five generations ago, my ancestors built lives in the high desert of New Mexico. Growing up fishing with my dad and running through the desert with my cousins, I fell in love with New Mexico’s natural wonders and learned that we all have a responsibility to care for our planet.
_Since my childhood, I have seen the impacts of climate change on New Mexico._
That’s why, when I was elected to Congress, I fought to protect sacred lands. As Secretary of the Interior, I helped protect more land and water than any administration in U.S. history while also creating good jobs in clean energy, conservation, and cleaning up legacy pollution.

Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have worked to gut environmental protections and sell off public lands — all while New Mexico stands on the front lines of the devastating impacts of climate change.
Governors are the first line of defense against the Trump agenda, especially when it comes to standing up against the brazen attacks on our environment. **And as Governor, I will be a fierce defender of our home, but I can’t win this race on my own.**

— Deb

Sixteen months ago, this campaign launched with a handful of us in a room and one belief: it shouldn't be this hard, in the richest country in the world, to see a doctor, pay your bills, or know your kids will have it better than you did.
**We carried that to every corner of the state. Now there's one job left: beat MAGA Mike Rogers and win a seat that could decide our Senate majority.**
Rogers got a head start. While we fought through an expensive primary, he ran unopposed, with Trump's backing and $45 million in spending building him up. And still, the race is tied. A recent poll has it locked at 45% to 45%.
**This seat is there for us to take. The only question is whether we reach voters before their money does.**
[**Will you split one of the very first donations of our general election between our campaign and Deb Haaland's campaign? A dollar right now buys the ads that define these races. I'm a doctor. Mike Rogers is the guy who introduced the bill that helped Big Pharma flood this country with opioids. More than 600,000 Americans died. He never apologized. Then he took $400,000 from the drug companies that profited.
As Detroit's health director, I spearheaded a program that will cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders. Rogers spent 30 years in Washington, left up to $14 million richer working for the same corporations he used to regulate.
I trust women to make their own decisions. Rogers voted for a national abortion ban, including one with no exceptions for rape or incest.

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: When Elon Musk's DOGE targeted the Saginaw Social Security office…
body:
|
#
Friend, **This week marks the 91st anniversary of Social Security being established.** In our district alone, over _200,000 people_ rely on Social Security – and many of them count on walking into the Saginaw field office to get real help from a real person when something goes wrong. So when Elon Musk's DOGE and the Trump administration targeted the Saginaw field office for closure last year, I fought back. Because closing it wouldn't have just been a budget cut – it would have meant folks driving further, waiting longer, or getting no help at all with the benefits they earned. We won that fight. The office stayed open. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137191399/639935679/1362877128?refcode=em-8.13.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMWFmMTAwYS01Yzk3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p6PEybpid8TZPSzIDRQC2mSfErIPe3_rgCX0gdL5fvs=) And I didn't stop there. I introduced legislation to make sure that Social Security recipients were protected from being unfairly penalized for overpayment errors. A mistake on Social Security's end shouldn't turn into a financial crisis for someone on a fixed income. In our district alone, over 200,000 people rely on Social Security – and many of them count on walking into the Saginaw field office to get real help from a real person when something goes wrong. So when Elon Musk's DOGE and the Trump administration targeted the Saginaw field office for closure last year, I fought back. Because closing it wouldn't have just been a budget cut – it would have meant folks driving further, waiting longer, or getting no help at all with the benefits they earned. We won that fight. Peter,

If you walk through downtown in too many American cities after dark, you can feel the change. Storefronts boarded up. People are sleeping in tents on the sidewalk. The sound of sirens that never seems to stop. Businesses that once stayed open late now close at dusk because the risk is no longer theoretical.

This did not happen by accident. **Radical Leftist district attorneys in major cities decided that entire categories of crime would be treated as inconveniences rather than offenses.** Bail policies turned arrest into a revolving door. Prosecutors announced they would no longer pursue whole classes of cases. When the predictable results arrived - higher theft, more open drug markets, braver repeat offenders - their response was to double down and attack anyone who noticed.

The human cost falls on the people who cannot afford private security or gated communities. Small business owners absorb the losses until they finally lock the doors for good. Working families change their routes home. Elderly residents stop going out after a certain hour. **The social fabric frays in plain sight while “Progressive” officials hold press conferences about root causes and systemic solutions that somehow never include consistent consequences for breaking the law.**

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

clean_body: The only way to change that is with tough-on-crime policies | Peter, If you walk through downtown in too many American cities after dark, you can feel the change. Storefronts boarded up. People are sleeping in tents on the sidewalk. The sound of sirens that never seems to stop. Businesses that once stayed open late now close at dusk because the risk is no longer theoretical. This did not happen by accident. Radical Leftist district attorneys in major cities decided that entire categories of crime would be treated as inconveniences rather than offenses. Bail policies turned arrest into a revolving door. Prosecutors announced they would no longer pursue whole classes of cases. When the predictable results arrived - higher theft, more open drug markets, braver repeat offenders - their response was to double down and attack anyone who noticed. The human cost falls on the people who cannot afford private security or gated communities. Small business owners absorb the losses until they finally lock the doors for good. Working families change their routes home. Elderly residents stop going out after a certain hour. The social fabric frays in plain sight while “Progressive” officials hold press conferences about root causes and systemic solutions that somehow never include consistent consequences for breaking the law. A society that refuses to enforce its own rules eventually loses the ability to protect the vulnerable. That is the trade that has been made in city after city. Order was treated as optional. The results are now visible on the streets. If you still think public safety is a core function of government rather than an outdated concept, the only way to push back is with sustained political and financial pressure. The soft-on-crime experiment continues because its architects face almost no electoral cost. | The people living with the consequences every day do not need another lecture about compassion. They need the basic protection that was once considered non-negotiable. That protection will not return on its own. The longer this approach remains in power, the harder it becomes to undo. Thank you, Coach Tuberville Meet Coach Tuberville: Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? Hi friend, We are incredibly excited to announce that Sue's comprehensive energy strategy, “New Energy for Rhode Island: Putting the Power Back in Our Hands” is now live! You can read it here:
---
| [ ](https://sue4ri.com/l/hPOxitUWu5sk)
---
If you don't have time to read the full thing, here's the TLDR.
---
Written in partnership with energy experts, legislators, and community advocates, this plan outlines the key legislative and administrative strategies we need to:
* **Stabilize** energy rates for Rhode Island ratepayers
* **Diversify** energy sources away from polluting, erratically priced fossil fuels
* **Put Rhode Island on track** to achieving 100% renewable electricity by 2033, as legally mandated by the 2023 Renewable Energy Standard
* **Create and sustain** good, union jobs with family sustaining wages building the infrastructure we need
* **Combat** climate change, and its ever-increasing threats to our communities

---
More than 10 legislators have already signed on, and committed to partnering with Sue to implement this plan. Now it's your turn.

[ _**Click here to sign on to "New Energy for Rhode Island," and join leaders from around Rhode Island in fighting for an affordable, reliable, and clean energy future.**_ ](https://sue4ri.com/sign-sues-energy-plan?t=VmYXlpNprS11)

Peter, I recently wrote an op-ed about a topic that is really important to me. Here is the headline: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137191992/639937354/-499535588?refcode=260813_dr_oped_img&ms=260813_dr_oped&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTM1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjBhNTBmZC01ZTk3LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9JBCPtnS5-pUTe62qPlwsQeOuU0lXXlSjXD1aB3JTaQ=) For nine years in the General Assembly, I've operated under a simple rule: my job is to weigh the facts, listen to my constituents, and vote my conscience. body:
We aren’t waiting for the status quo to fix itself.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260813-1&t=1&akid=3867%2E587540%2Ee2U1cg)
Peter,
After our country goes through massive eras of corruption — like it did with Nixon or during the Gilded Age — a movement always follows to reform our system and fight back.
That moment is coming again. It’s a matter of when, not if.
At Leaders We Deserve, we aren't waiting around for the status quo to fix itself. We are laying the groundwork right now for an anti-corruption revolution powered by a multigenerational coalition of voters. We're uniting everyday people against a broken, corrupt system that keeps working families down while letting the ultra-rich hoard all the power.
We're playing the long game to build a political system that actually serves the people — not special interests. But to win these crucial battles in state legislatures and beyond, we have to do things differently.
**Unlike our opponents, we don't accept a _single penny_ of corporate cash.**
Our organization and the young, bold candidates we support rely entirely on grassroots power to run their campaigns and win. Because we refuse corporate checks, our leaders answer only to the people, not party bosses, the establishment, or wealthy donors.
When we give young, courageous leaders the resources to overcome the massive financial barriers in politics, we don't just win elections — we fundamentally change who holds power in America.
We have an actual plan to recruit, train, and elect the next generation of unbought, unbothered public servants. But we can't do it without you.
**[Will you pitch in $5 or whatever you can today to power this grassroots fight and help us build the movement we deserve?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260813_1_postcorrupt.LSF9Z4&refcode=em20260813-3867&amount=5&t=2&akid=3867%2E587540%2Ee2U1cg)**

Hi team,
There's a very clear difference between Dan Meuser and me. But this race isn't really about either of us.
**It 's about the kind of representative our part of PA deserves.**
One who invests our tax dollars in health care, or one who hands our money to billionaires.
One who roots out corruption, or one who cashes in on the stock market.
One who shows up, or one who hides from their constituents.
At the end of the day, this race is about **you.** It's about who will work for you, and who will only look out for themself.
**From day one of this campaign, I said[ my priority is always you.](https://substack.com/redirect/bc16185e-240a-47bf-9b8a-017e88c5b391?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I meant it.**

clean_body: Protect Hobbs. Flip the legislature. Deliver the trifecta. | = DAY TWO: STATES IN PLAY 4 days. 4 states. Races up and down the ballot. EMILYs List is supporting Democratic pro-choice women at every level in four of the most consequential states on the map. Today's state in play: ARIZONA | = Peter, Today, we made the case for Arizona. Here's our plan: 1. Keep Katie Hobbs in the governor's seat. Losing the governor's office would put every hard-won gain by Democrats — from abortion protections to vetoes of extremist legislation — back on the chopping block. 2. Keep Kris Mayes in the attorney general's seat. Kris is running in the most competitive attorney general race of the cycle. We must hold her seat so that she can continue her important work protecting Arizonans' rights and keeping powerful special interests in check. 3. Go on offense. Right now, a Democrat holds the governor's office — but Republicans still control both chambers of the state legislature. This is our shot to change that. Flip the legislature, and Arizona will have a crucial Democratic trifecta. That's the difference between blocking bad bills and actually passing legislation that will improve Arizonans' lives. This slate matters not just because of the governor and attorney general races at the top of the ticket, but also because of the nine EMILYs List women running for state Senate and House. Every one of them is a building block toward a Democratic trifecta in Arizona. But that doesn't happen without resources. The war in Iran has become the quagmire so many of us feared it would.

We are months in and nothing has worked. The cruel bombings didn't end it. Trump's threats didn't end it. Now the experts all agree there's no end in sight -- with no relief on gas prices and costs squeezing families here at home.

While working families pay for this war, the defense contractors and weapons manufacturers are cashing in. And a lot of that money finds its way right back into the campaigns of the politicians who are supposed to hold them accountable.

My opponent, Doris Matsui, is one of them.

**Days after signing a $500 million contract to manufacture weapons of war, Honeywell International wrote a maximum contribution to Doris Matsui's campaign. And she had no problem cashing that check.**

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquO38L98SklfBdoDq94y0bmNpGkqxcvbwAwPTl2twJS_FLmQA8qTW5a27te5Idc1RNr8q6vpnoBsBGFH-pRf2NmAFcYssm6PKWsUqFcyuwLAKYmqfaTNjT5pwMb3kq-U0l9F_9yZrfe94ebCB_0ToQ-GZcefG00exbvWW7tKdYZdOpwZDB6EZhCIAMAazhgj0SOJB7Ol16cSRwtiYrlCHO0B-xwlTw6BWgcS1t_s6njcecclPOq3gQtiCUTVTZrMlekUcWbTR0Bo54n46185TwyRiHQVot6hcSVOXeTtPVZvULKFD7a6tiFwLviWaLt4qqY8zlHJ0fJEVn8LE8Al0nzP3a5OpowiATb68Hn6ocKQA/4t5/FuZd2avZRDeq1XuzLi1UVw/h1/h001.SHoz6BEj7KJwHDXEmfu_92i8v63H3fzx2XeXjmOLWU4)
I have never taken a dime from corporate PACs, defense contractors, or AIPAC, and I never will. Because every dollar we pour into endless war is a dollar stolen from the families I'm running to fight for.

With RFK Jr at his side, Trump recently signed an executive order laying out his administration’s “ _gold standard_ ” vaccine recommendations. **This order calls for children to get fewer vaccines and reduce multi-vaccine dosing.** Measles is at a 35-YEAR HIGH, and Trump is ensuring cases of more childhood diseases come back to haunt us. #### The Unedited Transcript
So we have been reading the past few sessions, Virginia Giuffre's testimony. I think it's a deposition. There's different versions of different interviews, but I believe it's a deposition, but it's for the civil suit that she had starting in 2015 with Elaine Maxwell that is over defamation because obviously she came forward and said that Jeffrey Epstein and Prince Andrew and several others sexually abused her.
And then, you know, Ghislaine Maxwell denied everything. And so she has a civil suit against Ghislaine Maxwell that eventually ended a settlement out of court for an undisclosed amount. And then obviously, you know, five years later, Ghislaine Maxwell went to jail for supposedly 20 years. I picked this specific deposition and you will see kind of a A lean into the things that have to do with Ghislaine Maxwell because of the opportunity coming down the pike that she may be offered a pardon.
We're going to try to avoid that. So I figure anything that shows very clearly the, you know, evil actions that she's done is probably pretty helpful. But also, as of tomorrow, July 2nd, The clock runs out on Todd Blanch having to give us the rest of the files according to the lawsuit with Katie Fang.
I don't hold my breath that there will be a big stack of files tomorrow morning. However, we will keep pushing for that. And every time we do not get that, that will show that there is, you know, Somebody is violating the Epstein Transparency Act. A way that I am doing that myself, because everybody can do their own little part, is I FOIAed the missing pages from the Jane Doe for Hilton Head survivor documents.
We had 53 missing documents, and NPR discovered them, and then we were given 16. We still have 37 missing pages. Case is becoming more and more significant as we go along. And so I want those other 37 pages. I think they're very important. And I FOIA'd the DOJ today. Two things can happen. They could say, here you go.
Here's the other 37 pages. I don't think that's going to happen. If it did, that would be significant. We would have something to look at. We would see why they were withheld. Obviously, it's a case that involves Donald Trump, so they are not going to Want us to see it. But if they don't give it to me in the allotted amount of time or say that they can't give it to me, then that becomes a violation of the Transparency Act.
So we can then document that they violated the act and take a next step.

name: Enoch for Congress
subject: TONIGHT: Enoch for Congress Volunteer Meeting — 81 Days to Election Day!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
**Election Day is only 81 days away — and we need all hands on deck.** Please join us **TONIGHT for our Enoch for Congress Volunteer Meeting** as we organize for the final stretch of this campaign.
We have a lot happening — and even more to accomplish.
**Our campaign signs are IN!** We are actively **canvassing neighborhoods, dropping literature, phone banking, attending community events, recruiting volunteers, and getting our message in front of voters across Ohio's 8th Congressional District.**
Now we need your help to take this campaign to the next level.Whether you can give us an hour, an afternoon, one evening a week, or several hours every week, **there is a place for you on Team Enoch.** You do not need political campaign experience. We will provide the training, tools, and support you need.
**The meeting is at 7:00 PM.**
Here is the link for the meeting: [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/3055415156](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=99684ddcb8&e=c6e7dff14c)**The full link is at the bottom of this page!**

### TONIGHT'S VOLUNTEER MEETING AGENDA
**1\. Welcome & Campaign Update**
* Where we are with 81 days remaining
* Campaign priorities for the final stretch
* Our path from voter contact to GOTV

**2\. Upcoming Events**
We have several events approaching quickly and need volunteers to help us show up strong across the district, including:
* **Miami County Fair — August 14**
* **Black Family Reunion Parade — August 15**
* **Springfield Township Canvass & Lit Drop — August 15**
* **Darke County Fair — August 21**
* **Meet & Greet Fundraiser at Major Minor — August 27**
* Additional September events and community outreach

**3\. Signs Are Here!**
We will discuss:
* Yard sign requests
* Sign delivery
* Sign placement
* Identifying high-visibility locations
* Recruiting supporters willing to display signs

**4\. Canvassing & Literature Drops**
Our volunteers are already going into neighborhoods and talking directly with voters. We need more people who can:
* Knock doors
* Distribute campaign literature
* Help organize canvassing teams
* Drive volunteers
* Help with literature preparation

**5\. Phone Banking & Voter Outreach**
Not comfortable knocking doors? You can help from home.We need volunteers to:
* Call voters
* Contact supporters
* Recruit volunteers
* Make event reminder calls
* Help us reach voters who may not otherwise hear about this campaign

**6\. Upcoming GOTV Operation**
Getting voters to the polls will require a coordinated campaign across the district.We will discuss our growing **Get Out The Vote (GOTV)** operation and how volunteers can help us identify supporters, follow up with voters, distribute literature, make calls, canvass neighborhoods, and ultimately turn support into votes.
**7\. Volunteer Teams & Assignments**
We need help in virtually **every aspect of this campaign** , including:
* Canvassing
* Literature drops
* Phone banking
* Text banking
* Events
* Yard sign delivery and placement
* Volunteer recruitment
* Voter registration
* Fundraising
* Donor outreach
* Data and technology
* Administrative support
* Social media and digital outreach
* Election/GOTV activities

**8\. Questions, Ideas & Next Steps**
We want to hear from you. Bring your ideas, questions, and suggestions — and be prepared to choose an area where you can help.

### 81 DAYS. EVERY CALL. EVERY DOOR. EVERY VOTE.

| Dear Friend,
---
I’ve spent a lot of time ever since I awoke from my coma reflecting on the big picture of what my trial in Arizona is really all about.
---
I thought back to all the despicable things the vengeful Democrats have done to me...
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/cm9se7p9_SckDrWwGDZ9gjiDsduLRc7kFqLAeTqZ4hc-K_8X0kNOf29teMcPuz88EBk649rTDTJMp3DkE55-D2QX4FzI4ieupJgj_5yeR7E4D2MocTNB8BknoYLAIy0DHj25E2GJB5AzHvDou-vxVs3fZb75mCTA6xbkfF2-CuofxqMyarcKvemxZAqQeDqV1v3j4rY2bqWsiN4V-efikVC6adXcR6P9fEgI3PZKK8dM5DqykwE2T14pbnf-cgqku9Qs4j3LB2xtLvnkltE-GmkYm1POqHZ9gVmK1JsnyEAA33zktJhIuyQL__xBhQDBS1BzhXpJLav30KxUF4YOrgIiR1OfpwBsiAXS0cfi9wAO_cRRtLm8wQNhqljMUnFG5tIXwMtl8xPwX6MQ5OKuXH4SYIfxVSI0v3sh80i3NBA9_eoQ1J3Z-0j6BErf7du4SKlvckG3u_ECnZVxFPcEc60LklU7Cui2rEp23Ae2GNz1CiEuqPWfJXKfP7VfDiVTevkK9Eozogb1d3cC1PRfcSITqadWPny3GVvs2MYdrvVrXc3vnbyM3QOWGicfs3wQSQw5CFprl4K6HRwpK0KRrkFgOM73P6f4IzA-fOd-DGr-goJMlZrZS9GTDHNDL6cfy1eoGE2XCn1JVUy3REBHs7ISDBCpFIvXxyqC6sABp9q6DVHDK3U_9hnV-r79ELs/oetRTkR9bWHJx58A_Cs7u2mWnhKEwrTg/23)
__
---
_A dawn raid on my home.
Arresting me alongside President Trump as innocent men.
Freezing my bank accounts.
Seizing my assets.
Forcing me to the point of bankruptcy._
---
**And now, a vengeful Democrat Attorney General making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
The lunatic Left’s desire to DESTROY yours truly knows no bounds.
---
They even stripped me of my law licenses so I would have no means to defend myself, leading pundits in the media to label me a **“ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_!”**
---
But what I’ve come to realize ever since I came so close to death was that the pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**They can strip me of all I’m worth – _all I’ll ever be worth_ – but what I _REFUSE_ to surrender to the Democrats and their Deep State thugs is my LEGACY!**
---
And __that__ is what my final trial is truly all about, Friend.
---
**I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to “earthly possessions.”**
---
"__For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_
---
You see, this FINAL BATTLE for my freedom is about ensuring this injustice can _NEVER_ _AGAIN_ happen to another innocent patriot all for standing by what he knows to be right and true.
---
I pray to God that will be my legacy when we win this trial.
---
But now, as I fight with all I’ve got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU__.
---
Friend, I understand this was probably the last thing on your mind today. I get it. And that’s why I always say that if you can’t afford to help me in this fight, please delete this message and carry on with your day. Don’t even think twice about it.

name: Shelby Wiltz (via Democrats.org)
subject: We had a simple hypothesis. Here’s what we found:
body:
---
_“I think the regular person is suffering right now. Social services are not being funded properly, and the cost of gas is going up. Our access to proper food and housing is not proper or correct. People are really suffering.”

“I wish politicians knew that so many people in my community, regardless of socioeconomic status, are struggling. The biggest thing is the cost of gas, groceries, and housing and housing instability.”

“Tariffs need to go away. We’re paying the price with taxes on everything.”_ Hi there, Derek, this is Shelby Wiltz, the DNC’s Political Director. These are just a few of the key takeaways from thousands of voters who spoke to hundreds of volunteers throughout the **DNC’s _Local Listeners_ program.** In a couple of minutes I’m going to ask you to [**chip in $7 to the DNC,**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260813_8586_fr&refcode2=8592_22930333_ziam6R&akid=8592%2E22930333%2Eziam6R) but first, let me explain how the DNC is putting what we learned to use. **[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260813_8586_fr&refcode2=8592_22930333_ziam6R&akid=8592%2E22930333%2Eziam6R)** We hear a lot about what pollsters have to say about the state of our country. But we had a really simple, but ambitious, idea: We know that hundreds of thousands of Democrats voted in the 2020 presidential election, but sat out the election in 2024. What if we could find them and connect with them? And if we could connect with them, most political pundits would recommend just asking them simple questions and getting off the phone as quickly as possible. It’s a numbers game. But, what if we approached this project as organizers? What if we had open-ended conversations about what’s on their mind? What if we built _actual_ relationships and community with these voters? **Well, Derek, that’s exactly what we’ve been doing.** This year, more than 400 volunteers joined us to make 448,295 calls to voters who voted in 2020, but not 2024. **We had nearly 10,000 conversations with voters from 61 battleground districts across the country, and what we found could change the game for the midterms this year.** Here’s a statistic that may shock you: From January to July, _our volunteers had more conversations with voters than the number of votes that decided the House majority in 2024._ Derek, I’m beyond proud of what our organizers and volunteers were able to accomplish with these conversations, and I’d love to share some of our findings with you today:
* During every conversation, volunteers asked voters which issues were most important to them. Across all groups, voters named the rising cost of living as a top issue, and _78% of them said the country is headed in the wrong direction under Trump._
* We also asked voters what it would take for a candidate to earn their vote this year. Consistently, they said they wanted leaders who would fight for them, their families, and their communities. They agreed that candidates should be _for the working people._
* And — most importantly — **86% of these folks said that they plan to vote in the upcoming midterm elections this November.**

So much is at stake this November, and reaching every voter we possibly can is going to prove _critical_ to Democrats’ success up and down the ballot. **Having these conversations don’t just allow us to sway people in key districts to vote, they help us build trust with voters that Democrats may have lost in the past few years.** Here’s the truth: building trust is _key_ to winning elections. We’re already working to share our results with campaign staff, organizers, fellows, and volunteers on races up and down the ballot, all across the country. We hope that our findings from this program will help inform scripts for door-knocking and phone banking, campaign literature and messaging, paid media, and more. We also plan to share our findings with YOU. **Another _big_ truth is that the work to build trust in the Democratic Party across the country _is being powered by the people._** Over 99% of the donations the DNC receives are from grassroots supporters — _just like you_ — pitching in what they can, when they can, to fuel our fight to elect Democrats this year and well into the future. [**So here’s the part where I ask, Derek: Can I count on you to chip in $7, or whatever you can afford right now, to help elect Democrats at every level of government, and continue building the strong infrastructure we’ll need to keep winning in the years to come?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260813_8586_fr&refcode2=8592_22930333_ziam6R&akid=8592%2E22930333%2Eziam6R) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260813_8586_fr&refcode2=8592_22930333_ziam6R&akid=8592%2E22930333%2Eziam6R)**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Re: the ballroom
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
No backroom deals. No secret favors. No exceptions.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2991%2E4032634%2EbRcUd0)
---
In case you've been wondering: Yes, Donald Trump is still tearing up the White House to build himself a gold-encrusted ballroom. Despite the fact that a federal judge has already found that Trump likely doesn't have the legal authority to do this. His construction crew continues digging, demolishing, and pouring concrete while the courts sort it out. And don’t forget, Republicans _tried_ to slip $1 billion in taxpayer money into an ICE funding bill to cover costs tied to this ballroom for Trump to wine and dine his donors. Luckily, that proposal failed (sorry, Donald). But the whole thing raises an obvious question: Who is really paying for Trump's vanity project? I've launched an investigation into the contracting and approval process behind Trump's ballroom — and whether the corporate donors funding this project are expecting favors from the administration in return. [**Will you add your name today to support this investigation? We need to show that the American people demand answers about who's paying for this project, who's benefiting from it, and whether powerful interests are getting special treatment behind closed doors.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-east-wing-investigation?source=EW_EMZ32W_COR_ENG_20260813_F&t=8&akid=2991%2E4032634%2EbRcUd0) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-east-wing-investigation?source=EW_EMZ32W_COR_ENG_20260813_F&t=9&akid=2991%2E4032634%2EbRcUd0)
---
What we do know is that Donald Trump has wined and dined corporate executives from Meta, Comcast, Microsoft, Palantir, Lockheed Martin, Amazon, and Google (just to name a few) to try and solicit donations.
And we also know that many of those corporations donating to Trump’s ballroom are regulated by federal agencies, seeking regulatory approvals, or are currently under investigation by the Department of Justice. I’m sure I don’t need to tell you that this raises serious ethical concerns over any backroom deals and special favors being offered in exchange for donations.
That alone is enough to make your blood boil. But the thing that really makes me so furious about this whole little turducken of corruption, greed, and political overreach?
It’s that working families are worried about paying for groceries. People are losing their health care. But somehow, Donald Trump always finds time — and money — for his vanity projects.
Instead of lowering health care costs, he's building himself a ballroom.
Instead of helping families make ends meet, he's courting wealthy donors.
Instead of restoring trust in government, he's raising even more questions about who gets access and who's calling the shots.
The American people deserve transparency. They deserve accountability. And they deserve a government that works for them — not for Donald Trump's ego.
[**We need to investigate any potential corruption surrounding the construction of this ballroom and the source of the donations funding it. Please add your name to join me in demanding answers.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-east-wing-investigation?source=EW_EMZ32W_COR_ENG_20260813_F&t=10&akid=2991%2E4032634%2EbRcUd0)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

Last week, families, neighbors, and local first responders gathered across Howard County, Anne Arundel County, and neighborhoods throughout the nation to celebrate National Night Out.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-Aug2026-FR-NationalNightOut?&refcode=E31119-20260813-NationalNightOut-Image-Event&amount=0 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-Aug2026-FR-NationalNightOut?&refcode=E31119-20260813-NationalNightOut-Image-Event&amount=0]

Events like National Night Out showcase the best of our neighborhoods: trust, connection, and a shared commitment to keeping our families safe. But building truly safe communities also means facing the harsh realities we see every single day.

According to data from USAFacts [https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-die-from-gun-related-injuries-in-the-us-each-month/state/maryland/] , 716 people died from gun-related injuries in Maryland in 2024 alone. That isn't just a number on a page; that is hundreds of families grieving loved ones and neighborhoods left to pick up the pieces.

We cannot accept this crisis as normal. Throughout my time in public service, I’ve worked to pair strong local community partnerships with real legislative action. In the Maryland Senate, I worked to strengthen and enforce red flag laws to keep guns out of dangerous situations, banned untraceable ghost guns from our streets, and secured direct funding for local violence intervention programs that stop crime before it starts.

When we invest in our communities and back it up with common-sense gun safety, we save lives. Maryland has proved that smart reform works, and now we fight to bring that same commitment to Capitol Hill.

Extreme politicians in Washington are still blocking basic safety measures, like universal background checks and assault weapon bans, supported by the vast majority of Americans. We need the resources to stand up to extreme special interests and keep pushing for solutions that put our families first.

Thank you for standing with me in this work.

-Sarah Elfreth
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/] https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD [https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD] https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland [https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland] https://x.com/SarahforMD [https://x.com/SarahforMD]
Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her fiancé, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. Derek –
I'm asking voters to rehire me because the work is not done. Wherever I go, I hear frustration and concern from Virginians: Costs are out of control, from health care, to housing, to child care and utility bills. Our country has been propelled into another war of choice in the Middle East. The job market is shifting beneath our feet.
And the president doesn’t seem to have a plan. He doesn’t even seem to care. And his administration is in over its head.
But it’s not lost on me, we have to do more than just stand against President Trump. We've got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together:
🏥 It's time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care.
💾 We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we've got to ensure we don't have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation.
🇺🇸 We've got to stand up for America's critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage.
⚡ We've got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy.
🏠 We got to address the housing crisis by encouraging rehabilitation of existing structures, speeding up permitting, and making it easier for first-time homebuyers to obtain their first mortgage.
The path forward will not be easy but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight.
I'm going to campaign this year – as I always have – by getting out on the road, talking to voters face-to-face, telling them about my record, and most importantly showing them what I'll do if I get rehired.
And the next few weeks will be hugely consequential to the outcome of November’s election. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit.
A donation made today is an investment in the future we’re building together – and it truly couldn’t come at a more important time for our campaign or our country.
So I’m humbly asking, if you’re in a position to donate today, will you split a donation between my campaign and Tim Kaine's to help me hit my critical end-of-month goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-warner?amount=25]

| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2d1749dbf1e349af88b89dee5a21fd59&_e=HaXEa3SFUHGgwsWTLFnxrNVJKIDnTulg0h7KpDRD_9RoZV8AlvIZ66ijXIgAbYDnN5W_W1adt4I_H2y1hg2TCOTN7Lrx6x_fz3C8Oo4k2TKTPlu9RfxdU1KZqMGRgKbf_X4ZR6QWnBUrKOlm3DR4Ej2Ginj5xSZ7wSCOCpFo2rCcjWiY7YrIy4ljae3HitiKDOK7CWDVUbEL072pUxFRVQMwSHb0xk22EicRtjTW8u-ny2s-w5qE88c_hiueTTMVJelgw8JVvn9j8z19jc_Lpbn_Anz1910RUJ6sEtPlD3wc1KiCdnkyBnMYJG1hJl_NeAjVzGYIzXwNv7zxSdz9RwM5UIu5j_kYCaIe1_3NBP_5w63qp5pcNIsUQN9KH4Tw9ctxM3GnDiLqz_AdZ9mJWMhcdbBCYyfOu4NmialtsCXHgVmzrzAm8b-Al9GmL_CcIZhAHSaUSARYwR6nLlEztus2TchWt1zjx75pGanvhEID0OIp2v1mX1ylQDOlm2gzKJvlex6CkB_likPAZJ9xYY-JN_q9ipWQgNJhwghz8wM07JJptZLF9n1HX-Hf0PXJx4CLq5msUOymHS5ULgkDcMv_DCHNPK9JmyNUwvX5sXUN6FTNE50hdGNb3lJmsMBmjEr3JOGHNq43AIs5Q1UQP0RHAzE4BEKUTYfHowF_2jU%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...
