| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2d1749dbf1e349af88b89dee5a21fd59&_e=HaXEa3SFUHGgwsWTLFnxrNVJKIDnTulg0h7KpDRD_9RoZV8AlvIZ66ijXIgAbYDnN5W_W1adt4I_H2y1hg2TCOTN7Lrx6x_fz3C8Oo4k2TKTPlu9RfxdU1KZqMGRgKbf_X4ZR6QWnBUrKOlm3DR4Ej2Ginj5xSZ7wSCOCpFo2rCcjWiY7YrIy4ljae3HitiKDOK7CWDVUbEL072pUxFRVQMwSHb0xk22EicRtjTW8u_pw-sfeEuIgnVNK5grLwo7Cxu5L-Q2DLpTRmpqlQvC3U1R-6T8SwkBBzJ-eY0dQgSswjO3pIMIGbkyOLxq8lGqYCIJd7Q2ivWI8lEZWln_P_hC4KPmEUEtII10q9958KUSczN8Lx6l9dFFRmXPh9rbpRYPfkABCKVoF22q41iAnJSm3yrV8guvsYU89SFgJDkt1hiOgRI7kGj5Ac8rrnEG5XJSxHSQbIhJ88AsyQPKX7KWjxzQzY3C4QnPPXalZ0EkysrmXkv1n5d9CKJewuQewQ9w2DNk8_vON-xCvn3W7K591hElnE0mJLHSkuvbMnwUguZzeVuN07mAFPl9kYOT0ZDwzkoeSU13uT3Vq2UfJ_rYueVvj64BJTHPlEovd3EjYPJtA3rIlszTDbo-OslYZF4iVZ7DC6rmvly5XYjV_JkF1XRFif9Mb-tqnbN8suE%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2d1749dbf1e349af88b89dee5a21fd59&_e=HaXEa3SFUHGgwsWTLFnxrNVJKIDnTulg0h7KpDRD_9RoZV8AlvIZ66ijXIgAbYDnN5W_W1adt4I_H2y1hg2TCOTN7Lrx6x_fz3C8Oo4k2TKTPlu9RfxdU1KZqMGRgKbf_X4ZR6QWnBUrKOlm3DR4Ej2Ginj5xSZ7wSCOCpFo2rCcjWiY7YrIy4ljae3HitiKDOK7CWDVUbEL072pUxFRVQMwSHb0xk22EicRtjTW8u-oj9ItDYUUUcrMzlSGyIx6K36MvLALJFc1jqkDfnvDdglXvt1WaWg_xc9iJJ5z9TOEa7XVjSposiPw2zwTGLIDOOZkwtijSzBvcTzGG-EB79HIR9lxRGMVatHjzHX7tCKdmk5Cp8zX0jwZluicOIb42F5wXMaSCMBWHSe76StdSWwTD2QN5macXxAIS3SP2dTAPTa3F2Pr_2GChAQSaJZ1GOhRDKouSUD0wgWVV94CAETzqXe2Mn4-ummmaPX-TNjUle6weQxdI4cB-qWpr01bZnTYAxS7jvpmYOrqNCB1kPrNmMDoyetrxTn_lTSd6gN6nUYi-h1aBU_Oss1griSZhfkz2Upc23fEL9hcAYKPdp_s-KD4lDMXsaid03-OCJl7iF8ev4a-3GzkasiJxPCAcZZjAcNjKVyE8G-xILgExPdZAhg3cqHJOfrL_6BLVz4%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _**[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2d1749dbf1e349af88b89dee5a21fd59&_e=HaXEa3SFUHGgwsWTLFnxrNVJKIDnTulg0h7KpDRD_9RoZV8AlvIZ66ijXIgAbYDnN5W_W1adt4I_H2y1hg2TCOTN7Lrx6x_fz3C8Oo4k2TKTPlu9RfxdU1KZqMGRgKbf_X4ZR6QWnBUrKOlm3DR4Ej2Ginj5xSZ7wSCOCpFo2rCcjWiY7YrIy4ljae3HitiKDOK7CWDVUbEL072pUxFRVQMwSHb0xk22EicRtjTW8u-mHIuL1d-uKAL_ZOkrN511mdTvuwMz_SsaQXmSkKFWuZQcIL1V8py1nbFHlKAMPNMCHvcrArTE1N64f8q8WjnbjLpjQ6AOfpjxcKy_g6_f3ucCkRgwcX8Vn5UUxWBbtl8XDue4Mke7x90nN69NUC72qQDWUXGd79c56onuPXWjf0qYweazX1CRwsztQcjIp-zrq58ykOc92Pp-QXp_Tq42WSgHn0W1JIrzkJa_RIErLtY4zWVtjTwCZvd8boqf8wphjTAV5Sh02fMOi1s-rlCo8pmMCBfJ3TpsyPitptZF6wgeF-X8qj2KOJzuJDl0V111dBwXipjC_6QpqXUxgZ1G-62L5zesii69W97IuTaJRyO0mhEY38qoEq1ql_5oDqGSa48doSKXlp6QDxQhN9N1AG95sML-1nIwDBpCfLrm5Osor0VjwnW7lhs_G0xzrtw%3D)**_ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. _**[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2d1749dbf1e349af88b89dee5a21fd59&_e=HaXEa3SFUHGgwsWTLFnxrNVJKIDnTulg0h7KpDRD_9RoZV8AlvIZ66ijXIgAbYDnN5W_W1adt4I_H2y1hg2TCOTN7Lrx6x_fz3C8Oo4k2TKTPlu9RfxdU1KZqMGRgKbf_X4ZR6QWnBUrKOlm3DR4Ej2Ginj5xSZ7wSCOCpFo2rCcjWiY7YrIy4ljae3HitiKDOK7CWDVUbEL072pUxFRVQMwSHb0xk22EicRtjTW8u_44HtDFjQ8Quo_bmQjfmiZZkQoDcOL9JwbEqFNjWpsAWQV69AGu9YBM5bfFYz2utgmxyduzoT8va3kt5f0jB0ZwBYGVikZJbeZcFOqXw-qBRPZClKJHnfN2EZm0kXP5eofDYcY2RNzH4hofBcg-0qeCG-A0ERSAyA01nenCnVasVx9uqjmNOzrJshJ8_0wYfTo1YMTZfsnuPcDvsA2MsiaxOtmctgabAOZ_cZR3IwgbaawccOzu4ir2tZb3nb4_WAUYYPw5ek6b4er3-blKeJhfXKOZ1FFNR82fJldZ-HAvxsKYKer7IPnPo97AAjWCNp8gUEXlVycWCoS8Z3ckhTN_oO2-eZNtDo3IN0UO00LTVtbKZwe2pvYhAYE5JxgBXyKztyLVWiSII3eh0UDpYDdLQOUhtrQNOC70PYb_kEUhnln5FXSndXLFb7IrkULxYU%3D)**_ **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. _**[Knowing that, please consider a sponsorship gift of $125. That’s enough to sponsor one entire ‘Story Hour Kit’ yourself.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2d1749dbf1e349af88b89dee5a21fd59&_e=HaXEa3SFUHGgwsWTLFnxrNVJKIDnTulg0h7KpDRD_9RoZV8AlvIZ66ijXIgAbYDnN5W_W1adt4I_H2y1hg2TCOTN7Lrx6x_fz3C8Oo4k2TKTPlu9RfxdU1KZqMGRgKbf_X4ZR6QWnBUrKOlm3DR4Ej2Ginj5xSZ7wSCOCpFo2rCcjWiY7YrIy4ljae3HitiKDOK7CWDVUbEL072pUxFRVQMwSHb0xk22EicRtjTW8u-x1XZBbfdDy9zdO0h63I9mMFZDioAnzcWOFd4CND5AbDL4mteglKec-5Il3CwtIoBMZNqnQkJmsCXJwhhHYI3WS2hbetPv7H3JG9IR4WbqOcJeBZV12d9PzE4YOzO7fl7nqVA15q3zZOrXkgddddutLy6SeMhCnzpXYxw250xAFW5ju0m9VqLYE9HUpnsmWDKFpju7E37SVtXsoXPpE3FlyOXtAGJGTQ3nO7KXlb4K6DMgy3SEalaYuu2jkKz4T7gMB1FAH6lCxZpcqfEl7871xL4dHG81CYrY_5X0tVupISPJz5pSpv61SFyJb3kehH0hghJ0vRHeQrbFjKBE5sI6sAJ1yG-wXAA3H99obtYLsshwwyyFacUhLZYFGxg8nJeQi9A5K-hDCGUM8eibMNEWuGSu3lsIafQpVWbFd6yOx-PTQmsuO-uUeQTNCs8fUYk%3D)**_ Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.”

clean_body: | | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical. | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco... | | | | ...but that’s just not true.<\- this is a man leading “drag queen story hour.”< p style="box-sizing: border-box;"> | | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America, Kirk Cameron | | | BRAVE For Good 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301

Paul Begala here.
I've spent decades as a political analyst and strategist helping Democratic candidates get elected as governors, senators — and even a President.
So, I know a thing or two about what it takes to win.
And I'm going to tell you something I've learned the hard way: Winning isn't just about one candidate or one race. It's about infrastructure. It's about finding the right leaders early, betting on them before anyone else does, and giving them the resources to fight.
That's exactly what my friend Raja Krishnamoorthi is building with Equal Opportunity Now — and it's why I'm writing to you today.
Here's why this is so damn important, team:
Donald Trump's chaos and cruelty needs to be stopped — and we need to elect STRONG Democrats at every level to make it happen. Not just in one election. In every election, in every state, for years to come.
Raja is exactly the kind of leader to lead that charge.
He doesn't just talk about getting things done — he rolls up his sleeves and fights.
Raja's parents came to the U.S. in search of a better life, like millions of hard-working people who call our country home — and they found it. He went from living in Public Housing and depending on SNAP to a Law School graduate and Congressman.
So mark my words when I say this: he fight against Trump's chaos and cruelty is personal for Raja.
And Equal Opportunity Now is how he's channeling that fight into something bigger than any one campaign — finding and funding the causes and leaders who will take on the MAGA agenda and win.
I have no doubt Raja knows how to pick fighters — but Equal Opportunity Now needs the resources to back them.
That's why I need to sound the alarm: Right now, dark-money Super PACs are pouring MILLIONS into races across this country.
The MAGA machine is organized, funded, and ruthless. We need to build something just as strong on our side — and we need to start NOW.
So can I count on you?

# **Trump announces rally with New York Police to celebrate nationwide crime plummet**
President Trump will travel with AG Todd Blanche and FBI Director Kash Patel **[to Nassau County, New York, Friday to rally with police](https://substack.com/redirect/f0d0fbb9-dbaa-476d-9120-0889e120c976?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and highlight what his administration calls the largest year-over-year drop in violent crime since the FBI began tracking data in 1936.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f0d0fbb9-dbaa-476d-9120-0889e120c976?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump plans to cite 2025 FBI statistics showing an 18.1% drop in murder,** 18.5% decline in robberies, and decreases in rape, assault, burglary, larceny and motor vehicle theft, crediting his law-and-order policies.
* **The event follows the one-year anniversary of Trump 's National Guard deployment to Washington, D.C.,** which Patel said resulted in over 6,000 arrests, nearly 2,000 drug seizures and more than 1,300 illegal firearm seizures, with federal resources set to remain in the capital.

# **CCP-linked official buys building near White House, raising security alarms**
Philip Qiu, who has held multiple positions in Chinese intelligence and security arms, purchased the historic Securities Building roughly 650 feet from the White House for $8.4 million in July, **[according to a Daily Caller News Foundation investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6ae3a8-0469-429e-9a23-34166bdcd183?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6ae3a8-0469-429e-9a23-34166bdcd183?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Qiu 's background includes work with Shanghai's Public Security Bureau,** special forces-style training, and leadership roles within the United Front Work Department, which the House Select Committee on the CCP says blends influence operations with intelligence-gathering. He's also linked to individuals tied to China's Ministry of State Security.
* **National security experts said the purchase poses serious espionage risks,** citing potential surveillance capabilities near federal facilities. China expert Gordon Chang and others called for U.S. authorities to investigate and restrict foreign ownership of property near sensitive government sites.

| [ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84743&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3e1e7ef2452949c706dc7caa9762525e05a0aa8699a2c23c9aad241394212ee7)

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Big takeover

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-)
> "These people were brought to our country to vote. And they vote illegally. And the — you know, amazing that the Republicans aren't tougher on it. The Republicans should say, we want to take over. We should take over the voting in at least many — 15 places. The Republicans ought to nationalize the voting."
> \- Donald Trump, Dan Bongino Show, February 2, 2026
In coordination with the Trump administration, Texas last year flagged thousands of registered voters as potentially ineligible and kicked them off the rolls. It turns out that many were [wrongfully disenfranchised](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68032?t=3&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-), and that all of them were targeted because of their immigration background.
This purge, and others like it taking place across the country, is the result of more than a decade of Trump falsely claiming that immigrants are illegally voting with the help of Democrats. It’s also made possible by the failure of Democrats to take action on voting rights and immigration when they had the power to do so.
More ominously, it serves as a blueprint for a much larger national clampdown that seeks to stop naturalized citizens from voting and frighten eligible immigrants from registering. Trump knows he’s likely to lose the midterms. Knocking out a constituency that tends to vote for Democrats is his best bet for holding on to power.
It turns out that the guy trying to scare us about immigrants stealing elections is trying to steal the election by scaring immigrants.
In May of 2025, the Trump administration began demanding that state governments turn over unredacted voter registration databases, including driver’s license numbers and partial Social Security numbers –– from every state and Washington, D.C.
They claimed state voter rolls were needed, in part, to verify voters’ eligibility and prevent noncitizens from casting ballots in federal elections. That’s even though both the left-leaning [Brennan Center for Justice](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68033?t=4&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-), an organization that advocates for voting rights and campaign finance reform, and the [Heritage Foundation](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68034?t=5&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-), a conservative think tank, found that noncitizens have cast roughly 0.0001% of all ballots in recent elections.
Most states refused this unprecedented, unconstitutional request, and the administration’s efforts to sue them into compliance have largely failed in federal court. But Texas and a dozen other states chose to hand their full voter data to the
Department of Homeland Security for vetting through its Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements, or SAVE, system.
Nearly 3,000 Texans were flagged as non-citizens and removed from the state’s voter rolls. The problem is that the SAVE database contains outdated information, and many naturalized citizens were mistakenly flagged as noncitizens.
While some responded to their removal by providing proof of citizenship and were able to restore their right to vote, it wasn’t until voting rights groups in Texas [sued](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68035?t=6&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-), reporters exposed the flaws in the state’s data, and county registrars pushed back that the Texas elections director ordered counties to comprehensively reinstate voters who had been wrongly removed.
You’d think Texas would have learned something from the last time they tried this.
In January 2019, Texas Secretary of State David Whitley announced that he had a list of nearly 100,000 registered voters who were actually noncitizens and ineligible to vote. The claim came weeks after Texas Democrats had blown past expectations in the 2018 elections, winning two long-shot congressional races, 12 State House seats, and electing 19 Black women to district and county courts in Houston.
The Texans on that list were mailed letters notifying them that they’d been flagged as potential noncitizens. To contest the finding, they had to send a copy of their birth certificate, their passport or their naturalization documents to their county registrar. Those who didn’t respond within 30 days were removed from the voting rolls.
It turned out, however, that the list of illegal voters had been compiled from old driver’s license records that didn’t reflect the status of Texans who had since naturalized. As in the current case, the error only came to light because voting rights organizations sued the state to stop it.
In February 2019, U.S. District Judge Fred Biery [ordered](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68036?t=7&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-) Texas to stop the voter purges and the citizenship demand letters, citing the state’s bungled vetting process and lack of proof of noncitizen voting. Biery called the attempted purge “a solution looking for a problem.”
Even with good intentions, he wrote, “the road to a solution was inherently paved with flawed results, meaning perfectly legal naturalized Americans were burdened with what the Court finds to be ham-handed and threatening correspondence from the state which did not politely ask for information but rather exemplifies the power of government to strike fear and anxiety and to intimidate the least powerful among us.” He argued that the effort conflated immigration with illegal voting, adding, “No native born Americans were subjected to such treatment.”
We may never know how many naturalized citizens managed to get their voting rights restored and how many decided it wasn’t worth tangling with a government that had demanded they prove their citizenship before they could vote again.

_Great-great-grandfather Bernard O’Rourke became a U.S. citizen in 1868._
But we do know that interfering in elections by purging legally registered naturalized immigrants will continue. Already states like Virginia, Ohio and North Carolina [have employed](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68037?t=8&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-) similar tactics to those used in Texas, with similar results.
In Alabama officials purged 3,251 voters “by cross-checking the voter rolls with a database of people who had been issued noncitizen identification numbers from the Department of Homeland Security” and then later admitted that at least 2,000 of them were in fact legally registered to vote.
But Trump won’t be able to affect the November outcome relying on state-by-state efforts. So he’s now using all the leverage he has to push through the SAVE Act in Congress, which, if it becomes law, will mandate the cross-referencing of all state voter files against these flawed federal databases that have already produced so many wrongful voter purges in states like Texas.
Even if those who are wrongfully flagged eventually get reinstated, that might come too late for them to actually vote in November. And the consequences extend beyond the eligible voters who will lose their ability to participate in these elections. If the SAVE Act passes, it could also appear to legitimize the president’s false claims that immigrants are illegally voting, undermining trust in elections and preparing the ground for him to challenge Republican losses during the upcoming midterms.
The SAVE Act would make Texas’s approach the law everywhere, mandating the same flawed database checks in every state, with far less room for the kind of scrutiny that stopped this most recent purge before it went further.
Congress still has a chance to block it. If it doesn’t, the next purge will be big enough to change the outcome of elections across the country. More than 20 million naturalized citizens are currently eligible to vote — how many will be turned away if Trump succeeds?
Even if he can’t get the SAVE Act through, Trump will continue to lie about immigrants and voting to undermine faith in elections that his party is almost certain to lose. He has repeatedly used the specter of noncitizen voting to explain his losses and justify his attempt to nationalize federal elections. He claimed he would have won the popular vote in 2016 had [5 million](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68038?t=9&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-) illegal immigrants not voted. Earlier this summer he alleged that hundreds of thousands of noncitizens are registered to vote in just [four states where Democrats are in charge.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/68168?t=10&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-)
That’s why Democrats need clear, decisive wins at every level, strong enough to withstand the president’s efforts to interfere. We must register and turn out enough new voters to make up for those who will be wrongfully purged from the rolls as we also seek out those who should have their voting rights reinstated. In Texas, I volunteer with [Powered by People](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=11&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-) whose members personally meet and register those most targeted for voter suppression — including naturalized citizens — to help them vote and to help restore their voting rights when they are wrongfully purged.
And when Democrats achieve these overwhelming victories, they must use their newly won power to protect voting rights and fix the underlying challenges that Trump is so successfully exploiting.
That means passing voting rights legislation modeled on the Voting Rights Act of 1965 which helped ensure that Black Americans could finally register and vote after decades of being locked out of elections. The John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, languishing in legislative purgatory since 2015, would restore much of what’s been gutted from the original VRA by the Supreme Court and extend its protections to communities, including naturalized citizens, who now face a new kind of Jim Crow.
But it also means ending the talk of rewriting our immigration laws and actually burning the political capital once in office to do it. Presidents Obama and Biden both enjoyed Congressional majorities in their first two years in office. While they used that power to win impressive victories on healthcare, Covid response and climate change, immigration was left undone. That created a political opening for Trump, who blamed Democrats for failing to address the issue and used it to push his lies that undocumented immigrants threatened the country and were trying to steal elections.
If they win majorities in November and the White House in 2028, Democrats should embrace the opportunity to legalize the status of those Americans who’ve earned the chance to come out of the shadows, and provide a safe, orderly and legal path for new immigrants to join their families, flee persecution and contribute to the greatness of this country. That would do more than anything else to secure the border, regularize immigration and end the ICE terror campaigns in our communities. Americans don’t hate immigrants, they hate the chaos, confusion and cruelty of the status quo.
Trump won twice by demonizing immigrants in the wake of Democratic inaction. He is now trying to use the lie that immigrants are committing voter fraud to disenfranchise new citizens and create doubt about November’s election. We can fight back by working to ensure that every eligible citizen, naturalized or native-born, can vote. And then use the hard-won political power their votes make possible to deliver an immigration system worthy of this country.
That’s how we make good on the promise of a government of, by and for the people – all of them.
Thank you,
Beto

PS: [**If you'd like to donate to support the organizing work we're doing at Powered by People, you can chip in here.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260813.5gIJ3s&refcode=ema20260813-241009&t=12&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-)

[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pbp-em-2023-footer?refcode=em20260813-241009-footer&t=13&refcode2=241009_444211_DXghO-&akid=241009%2E444211%2EDXghO-)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

* [Update My Personal Information](https://act.betoorourke.com/signup/update-contact-information/)

That would do more than anything else to secure the border, regularize immigration and end the ICE terror campaigns in our communities. Americans don’t hate immigrants, they hate the chaos, confusion and cruelty of the status quo. Trump won twice by demonizing immigrants in the wake of Democratic inaction. He is now trying to use the lie that immigrants are committing voter fraud to disenfranchise new citizens and create doubt about November’s election. We can fight back by working to ensure that every eligible citizen, naturalized or native-born, can vote. And then use the hard-won political power their votes make possible to deliver an immigration system worthy of this country. That’s how we make good on the promise of a government of, by and for the people – all of them. Thank you, Beto PS: - -

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

I can tell we’re getting to them.

Peter, when the Vice President came to North Carolina to attack me by name, **I knew we were in for a long race.**
When President Trump followed up a few weeks later with a late-night Truth Social post attacking me again, **I knew they were nervous.**
Now, after President Trump’s attack dog Stephen Miller went on Fox News to rant and rave about me, **I can tell we’re getting to them.**
There are a lot of important Senate races happening this year, but President Trump knows that if they just win in NC, it’ll stop our chances of taking back the Senate. It won’t matter what happens in other swing states. If our MAGA opponent – former Big Oil and utility lobbyist Michael Whatley – wins here, that’s the ballgame. Republicans will likely keep Senate control until 2029.
That’s why we’re facing these nonstop attacks, and why I’m emailing you today. We’re facing our mid-month deadline on Saturday, and we’re behind our goal. If we miss this goal, it’ll make it much harder to run the ads we need to win – and this is a race we just can’t afford to lose.

As Attorney General, I'll fight these practices, protect workers' rights, and defend the laws that ensure fair pay, safe workplaces, and equal opportunity. I’ll build on my work as Secretary of State, where I’ve cracked down on fraudulent business filings and protected small businesses from misleading solicitations. This November, you have a choice between someone who will stand up for hardworking Coloradans and someone who has aligned himself with Donald Trump and powerful interests. I'll stand with you. Hi, I’m just asking for 30 seconds of your time. I know it’s late, so I’ll be quick.
I’m working around the clock to win this U.S. Senate race here in Ohio, and thanks to supporters like you, the momentum behind our campaign is surging. I’m endlessly inspired by the hundreds of thousands of folks who are joining us in the fight to give working people their voices back in Washington.
